izzyondroid:com.sergenious.mediabrowser.name: Media Browser
izzyondroid:com.sergenious.mediabrowser.summary: Media Browser lists and views images and videos through directories (folders)
izzyondroid:com.sergenious.mediabrowser.description:
Description
 Media Browser allows listing and viewing images and videos through directories (folders) on the internal and external storages on Android phones. Unlike the default stock or most 3rd party photo gallery applications, which display all the images as a flat list, sorted by date, Media Browser allows the user to select a specific directory, and display only its images. It also allows sorting by the file name, which is lacking in most of the other gallery applications.
 Media Browser displays full EXIF data of JPEG images, and contains a files sizes viewer.
 Media Browser includes a 360-degree panoramic viewer, with a rectilinear or spherical mode.
 Media Browser does not contain ads and is and will always be completely free.
 Directory listing
 Media Browser list all the storages, and allows adding or removing the shortcuts to the frequently used directories.
 Long pressing on any item opens a selection mode, where a slideshow from all the selected directories can be started. It also allows displaying the hierarchical sizes of all the files in the selected directory.
 When selecting a storage or a shortcut, a directory listing is displayed.
 Sub-directories and images are displayed together. There is a menu option to show or hide file names (labels) over the files.
 Title bar displays the name of the directory, together with the number of the items (files and sub-directories) in the selected directory.
 There is a menu option to start a slideshow of all the files, including the recursive sub-directories.
 An option for a recursive search by file is included.
 Media viewing
 Media files are swipeable to the previous and the next file (if existing). Images can be zoomed by 2-finger gestures.
 Full EXIF information is displayed with the JPEG file details.
 When displaying panoramic images (360-degree or less), a marker is displayed over the image, indicating the panoramic viewer option.
 Panoramic viewer in a spheric mode, when fully zoomed-out, displays a "tiny-planet".
 Panoramic viewer can also work in a rectilinear mode.
 File sizes
 Similar to the "Disk usage" application, Media Browser can display the cumulative directory and file sizes of the selected directory, making finding big files easier.

fdroid:com.acutis.firewall.name: Acutis Firewall
fdroid:com.acutis.firewall.summary: Parental control app that blocks adult content and dangerous sites on-device.
fdroid:com.acutis.firewall.description:
Acutis Firewall is a parental control app that protects your family by blocking adult content, malware, and dangerous websites. All filtering happens locally on your device for maximum privacy.
 Key Features 
 Content Protection 
• Block adult and pornographic websites with a comprehensive blocklist
• Protect against malware and phishing attacks with real-time DNS filtering
• Optional blocking for gambling sites and social media platforms
• Works across ALL apps, not just browsers
 Time-Based Controls 
• Set daily screen time limits for specific sites or categories
• Schedule blocking during homework time, bedtime, or family hours
• Choose which days of the week rules apply
 Parental Controls 
• PIN-protect settings so children cannot disable protection
• One-tap activation with no configuration required
• Auto-start protection when device boots
 Privacy First 
• All filtering happens on your device - no data sent to external servers
• No analytics, tracking, or data collection
• DNS queries go to your network's resolver or one you choose
• PIN stored with Android's encrypted storage
 How It Works 
Acutis Firewall creates a local VPN tunnel on your device to intercept DNS queries. When a blocked domain is requested, it returns "not found" - preventing the content from loading. Allowed traffic passes through normally with no slowdown.
 Requirements 
• Android 10 or higher
• No root required
• No subscription - completely free and open source
Named after Blessed Carlo Acutis, patron of the internet.

This simple game requires a lot of luck and a very small amount of skill. In
times past, this game was used as a gambling or drinking game by sailors and
merchants alike. You must procure a ship (6), a captain (5), and a crew (4), the
remainder is your cargo.
Once you have your ship, captain, and crew, you can click on dice that you wish
to hold in order to save them rather than roll them. You can also choose to keep
them all if the conditions are right. The "point" or high score is always
visible, and that is a big help to the "hammer" or the last player.
This game is open source and add free! So grab a couple friends and set sail for
high adventure with this fun little dice game. If your lucky, you may even
strike "midnight"!

fdroid:com.pilcrowmd.name: Markdown Reader - PilcrowMD
fdroid:com.pilcrowmd.summary: Read & edit Markdown beautifully. No ads, no account, open source.
fdroid:com.pilcrowmd.description:
PilcrowMD is a beautiful, distraction-free Markdown reader and editor for Android. Open a .md file and see it as a clean page: serif type, a calm dark theme and plenty of space, so long documents are easy to read on a phone.
It is made for the Markdown you meet every day: answers from AI assistants, README files, technical docs, notes and specs. Save an AI chat answer as Markdown and PilcrowMD shows the headings, lists, tables, code and math cleanly, not as raw symbols.
WHY PILCROWMD
- Beautiful reading first. Premium serif type, a calm dark theme, a warm cream light theme, and a layout made for reading, not a cramped code editor.
- Free, no ads, no account, no tracking. No analytics, no crash reports. Fully open source (GPL-3.0).
- Never loses your work. Saving writes back exactly what you wrote. No silent reformatting, no half-written files.
- Read and edit. Switch between the clean reading view and a real source editor with syntax highlighting, line numbers, and undo/redo.
- Export to PDF. Save any document as a clean, print-ready PDF. Code blocks print on a light panel, in colour.
- Fast and offline. Native Android, works with no connection. Mermaid diagrams are drawn on your phone, offline, and the app has no internet permission.
EVERYTHING MARKDOWN
- CommonMark + GitHub Flavored Markdown
- Tables, task lists, strikethrough, and links
- Syntax-highlighted code blocks
- LaTeX math ($$…$$)
- Pictures stored next to your note show inside the document. Web pictures are never downloaded
- YAML front matter
- Callout boxes (note, tip, warning) and collapsible sections
- Wide tables and code scroll sideways without breaking the page
READER TOOLS
- Search inside the document, with highlighted matches and next/previous
- Table of contents built from your headings. Tap to jump to any heading
- Links inside a document take you to the right heading, including Chinese and other non-Latin headings
- Buttons to jump to the top or bottom appear while you scroll
- Remembers where you stopped reading, per file
- Open .md files straight from your file manager or an email attachment
- Adjustable text size and a choice of reading fonts
- Full-screen reading: hide the top bar, status bar and navigation bar while you read
NOTES FOLDERS
- Add a folder of notes and browse it in My folders. New or changed notes are marked until you open them
- Tap a link to another note to open it, and press Back to return
- Browsing never changes, renames or deletes your files
MADE FOR
- Reading and saving answers from AI assistants and large language models
- README files and project docs on the go
- Technical specs, notes and meeting docs
- Anyone who works with .md or .markdown files
PilcrowMD opens .md, .markdown and .txt files. No sign-up, no ads. Just the cleanest way to read and edit Markdown on Android.

fdroid:com.safekey.authenticator.name: Osmium
fdroid:com.safekey.authenticator.description:
Osmium is a privacy-first, fully offline authenticator for two-factor codes (TOTP/HOTP): codes are generated on-device and work without any network connection.
• Codes are computed entirely on-device — no account, no sign-up, and no telemetry.
• No connections at start-up. Osmium goes online only when you ask it to: the automatic update check is off by default, and the Terms of Use / Privacy Policy are downloaded from osmium.im only when you open them.
• Secrets are encrypted with a non-exportable key in the Android Keystore before they are written to disk.
• TOTP and HOTP: 6/7/8 digits, SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512; Steam Guard codes supported.
• Organize accounts with tags and search.
• Import from other apps: Google Authenticator (QR migration), Aegis, 2FAS and other common backup formats.
• Encrypted export & restore to a local file or your own WebDAV server; encrypted quick transfer between two devices on the same Wi-Fi.
• Modern Material 3 design with light/dark themes and Material You colours.
• Fully open source (GPL-3.0-or-later); release builds are reproducible — anyone can verify that the published APK matches the source code.
No ads, no trackers, no analytics.
Website: https://osmium.im
Source code: https://github.com/lihongxi-g/osmium-authenticator

fdroid:dev.astoris.ursa.summary: Native Android client for Uptime Kuma with FOSS push, no Google services.
fdroid:dev.astoris.ursa.description:
URSA keeps every self-hosted Uptime Kuma monitor a glance away on your phone.
Connect directly to your server for live state, incident context, management, and
private push without an account, analytics, Google services, or a paid relay.
Features:
* Live monitor state, response-time trends, uptime, heartbeat history, and TLS
 certificate detail.
* Incident, certificate, domain, event, 30-day aggregate, and pinned-live fleet
 views for fast triage.
* Search, quick filters, advanced filters, saved views, favourites, groups, tags,
 compact rows, and responsive tablet layouts.
* Multiple encrypted server connections with password/TOTP or imported sessions,
 optional self-signed TLS, and up to eight custom access headers for Pangolin,
 Cloudflare Access, and similar reverse proxies.
* Create and safely edit common monitor settings, including SFTP password or
 private-key access, assign notification providers, manage groups/tags, run
 confirmed bulk pause/resume, and manage maintenance.
* UnifiedPush alerts through a distributor you choose, including per-monitor modes,
 severity, quiet hours, delays, repeats, acknowledge/snooze, and managed Kuma setup.
* Slow-response and certificate-expiry alerts generated locally on your device.
* Public status pages with native groups, uptime, recent checks, maintenance, and
 incident history.
* Encrypted portable backups, encrypted offline cache, optional biometric/device
 credential lock, and sensitive screens protected in release builds.
* Native Android extras: widget, Quick Settings tile, shortcuts, scoped deep links,
 notification actions, and an opt-in always-on glance display.
* Light/dark mode with Kuma status colors and optional Material You.
* Optional manual check for stable releases from URSA's official GitHub repository.
A separate Wear OS APK is available from GitHub Releases with a standalone public
dashboard, detail view, tile, complications, and optional same-signed phone pairing
for private monitor actions. The F-Droid phone build remains free of Play Services.
URSA is free and open source with no ads, tracking, premium tier, or subscription.
It is an independent client and is not affiliated with Uptime Kuma.

fdroid:io.simplelogin.android.fdroid.name: SimpleLogin | Anti-spam
fdroid:io.simplelogin.android.fdroid.summary: Protect your email inbox with a secure and open source solution by SimpleLogin
fdroid:io.simplelogin.android.fdroid.description:
Application features: 
 Manage aliases: create/edit/delete & enable/disable an alias.
 Manage contacts: create contacts to send email from your aliases.
 Manage mailboxes: create/delete/make default a mailbox.
 Share extension: create alias without leaving your browser.
 Secure login with Two Factor Authentication (2FA).
 Support self-hosted: you can use this application with your own SimpleLogin instance.
And many more features in active development.
********************************************************************************************
 SimpleLogin is an open source solution to protect your email inbox. It allows you to create quickly a random email address (aka alias). All emails sent to an alias are forwarded to your personal email address. You can use the alias when subscribing to a newsletter, signing up for a new account, giving your email to someone you don't trust. Not only an alias can receive emails, it can also send emails. An alias is a full-fledged email address. Later you can simply block or delete an alias if it's too spammy.
 Why SimpleLogin? 
When you give away your personal email online, there is a good chance that your email address would end up with a spammer or a hacker. SimpleLogin acts as a firewall to protect your personal email inbox.
 What distinguishes SimpleLogin: 
 Open-source and easy to self-host. The self-hosting is based on Docker and could be run on almost any Linux server. The hosting instruction is on our repository at https://github.com/simple-login/app 
 Powerful features if you have a domain (only available at premium plan).
 Generous free plan: there's no cap on bandwidth or number of replies/sends. The Free Plan is enough for protecting your personal email. Premium Plan targets at more "advanced" users with features like custom domain, unlimited alias or catch-all alias.
 Open Roadmap with exciting upcoming features: email directory, extension for Safari, mobile applications, etc. Feel free to check it out on https://trello.com/b/4d6A69I4/open-roadmap 
 Export your data: allows you to change the service provider if someday you decide to leave SimpleLogin.
Terms and conditions: https://simplelogin.io/terms/ 
Privacy policy: https://simplelogin.io/privacy/

WHY ENCRYPT YOUR DNS?
HTTPS protects the content exchanged with websites, but traditional DNS lookups may still be unencrypted. These lookups translate domain names into IP addresses and can reveal the domains your device requests.
Encrypted DNS helps protect queries between your device and your chosen DNS provider from eavesdropping and tampering. Your provider still handles those queries, so choose one whose privacy practices you trust.
EVERYDAY DNS CONTROL
• Use DNS over HTTPS or DNS over TLS.
• Choose built-in profiles for Cloudflare and Google.
• Enable or disable your DNS configuration from the app.
• Choose whether DNS settings apply on Wi-Fi, cellular, or both.
• Check DNS protocol and provider details in the Status tab.
PRO TOOLS INCLUDED FROM THE START
DNS Security Pro includes the everyday DNS controls above and all of these advanced tools:
• Create custom DoH and DoT profiles.
• Use built-in AdGuard profiles and download profile updates.
• Skip encrypted DNS for some domains or networks.
• Sync custom DNS profiles and optional Wi-Fi rules with iCloud.
• Enable or disable DNS for specific Wi-Fi SSIDs.
• Switch profiles with Shortcuts and URL schemes.
• Compare DNS profile response times with the built-in speed test.
No additional Pro upgrade purchase is required in DNS Security Pro. The separate free DNS Security app offers these advanced tools through its optional Pro in-app purchase.
DESIGNED AROUND PRIVACY
DNS Security manages your device's DNS configuration and does not collect personal information. DNS requests are handled by your selected provider under that provider's privacy policy. Encrypted DNS protects DNS queries; it does not make all browsing anonymous. Blocking malicious domains depends on the provider and profile you choose.
AUTOMATE YOUR DNS
Use Shortcuts or a compatible app to open a switch URL and select a DNS profile with your preferred network settings.
Example: select google-DOH for Wi-Fi, with cellular disabled:
dnsapp://switch?config=google-DOH&enableOnWifi=true&enableOnCellular=false
Use the scheme for your installed app:
• DNS Security Pro: dnssecuritypro://
• DNS Security: dnssecurity://
• Shared scheme: dnsapp://
Replace dnsapp in the example with your app's scheme. The requested profile must already exist in the app. Initial activation may require selecting DNS Security in iOS Settings.

apple-macos:6784185201.name: MetricBridge: Health Data
apple-macos:6784185201.description:
Your Apple Health data, answered on your iPhone and handed to the AI agent you already use.
MetricBridge answers plain-language questions about your Apple Health data on the device, and exports 194 metrics as clean JSON to a destination you choose, so your own AI agent can read your real numbers.
ASK YOUR DATA
Type "how's my resting heart rate trending this week" and get an answer built from your own history.
• Every figure is computed by ordinary code in the app, not guessed by a model
• It shows the metric, date range and days of data used, so you can check the work
• Runs on your iPhone. The question, the data and the answer stay on the device, unless you turn on Your Mac, which sends one answer's numbers to your own Mac on your Wi-Fi
• Weekly Brief: a short recap of your week, written on device
IT KNOWS ITS LIMITS
Ask something clinical, like "should I stop taking my statin", and it declines, then offers your data instead.
TODAY, WITH THE WORKING SHOWN
A Today card compares last night with your own usual, not a population average: HRV status, sleep shortfall, changes worth a look, a readiness estimate and a fitness age range. Tap it to see every input, the fixed weights and anything missing. The method is published at healthexport.dev/methods. It describes patterns in your own data, not a diagnosis.
TRAIN, SLEEP, EXPERIMENT
• Training load: your last 7 days against the 28 before, with heart-rate zones
• A strength log for sets, reps and weights
• Tonight's suggested bedtime and a 28-day Sleep Regularity Index
• Lab: test one change against your own nights. Days are set at random and the result stays hidden until the end
Training load shows effort. It is not an injury prediction.
ON YOUR WRIST AND IN SIRI
• Apple Watch shows your Today card and offers complications. The watch app reads no Health data itself
• "Ask MetricBridge" answers by voice with the numbers it used. "Get Readiness Estimate" feeds your shortcuts
194 METRICS AS CLEAN JSON
Activity, heart, HRV, mobility, respiratory, body, sleep, hearing and nutrition, plus workouts. Written as JSON or CSV to a destination you pick: your iCloud Drive, a folder on your device, your own network over HTTP or WebSocket, or any webhook URL you trust.
Background auto-export keeps the file fresh. Every delivery is token-authenticated, and the in-app history shows each run.
AN MCP SERVER FOR YOUR AGENT
MetricBridge ships a zero-dependency, open-source MCP server that you install on your own computer. It gives any MCP client 21 tools for trends, comparisons, workouts, sleep and correlations. Nineteen only read. Two only add or remove your own events, in a separate file. No tool writes to Apple Health.
Your agent reads only after you pair it with a code from the app.
DOCTOR REPORT
Make a clear PDF summary of your data to bring to a visit. It is a summary of numbers, not medical advice.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• The app reads Apple Health and never writes to it
• No account, no sign-in, and no ads inside the app. Your health data is never used for advertising
• No third-party AI service is involved, and no health data reaches a server we operate
• Reproductive health, sexual activity and alcohol stay excluded unless you turn them on
• What each on-device answer mode sends: healthexport.dev/on-device-ai
ONE PURCHASE, THREE DEVICES
MetricBridge for Mac opens your iPhone export on a bigger screen. Mac and Apple Watch come with the same purchase.
PRICING
A 7-day free trial, then a single one-time purchase that unlocks everything permanently: export, Ask, the Today card, training, Lab, the Apple Watch and Mac apps, Siri and Shortcuts, and the Weekly Brief. Not a subscription. Nothing renews.
MetricBridge is a tool, not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat or provide medical advice.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.healthexport.dev/privacy

apple-macos:6752025927.name: bite: Good Food, Shared
apple-macos:6752025927.description:
Bite is an all-in-one recipe app, social cookbook, and meal planner that helps you save & organize recipes ad-free, import recipes from anywhere, and build your personal cookbook. It is built around the idea that every favorite recipe comes from someone you know. I always found my favorite recipes through friends and family, so I created Bite - a place that gives people access to the recipes of their inner circle.
Instead of losing recipes in screenshots, texts, notes, or saved reels, Bite keeps them all in one clean and fun app.
IMPORT RECIPES FROM ANYWHERE
Stop copying out recipes by hand. Share an Instagram cooking reel or post to Bite and the recipe is pulled from the caption. Share any recipe website, or paste a link, and the recipe is read off the page. Photograph a handwritten card or cookbook page and Bite transcribes it. You can even turn photos of a dish you cooked into a draft recipe. Every import lands in your cookbook already saved and formatted.
RECIPE DISCOVERY
Discover recipes from friends, family, or the web. Bite is connected with Google Search, so you can find millions of recipes in a clean ad-free format inside the app. Follow your friends & family and discover their recipes on their profiles or by scrolling the food feed!
SAVE RECIPES
Save and organize recipes into folders, and edit any recipe you save. While viewing a recipe, add ingredients to your grocery cart by tapping them, and cross off steps as you cook. You can also scale servings and switch between metric and imperial - the original recipe is never changed.
PERSONAL COOKBOOK
Turn your tried & loved recipes into a structured cookbook to reference later and share with your circle! Snap a picture of a meal you cooked and upload it with the recipe. Tried a friend's recipe? Tap "add to cookbook" to grow your cookbook and inspire others.
SOCIAL COOKING APP
Follow friends and family to see what they are cooking. Share recipes with photos and build a social cookbook together. You can also share any recipe via iMessage, WhatsApp, and more.
FOOD PHOTO POSTS
Post what you cook, attach optional recipes, and build a visual food diary that becomes your own cookbook.
MEAL PLANNER & GROCERY LIST
Plan your day of meals with the in-app calendar, and use the grocery list to track what you need to buy while in-store.
WHY BITE
Most recipe apps only save links from the internet. Bite is different - it is a social recipe app and cookbook built around your inner circle. You don't just save recipes, you build a living cookbook with friends, family, and your own cooking history. Every meal you love becomes part of it.
KEY FEATURES:
• Import recipes from Instagram, websites, and photos
• Social cookbook with friends and family
• Recipe finder, saver and organizer
• Personal cookbook builder
• Meal planner and grocery list
• Cooking helper: cross off directions as you cook
WHO IS BITE FOR:
• Home cooks and beginners learning recipes
• Friends/families sharing recipes and traditions
• Anyone who saves recipes from Instagram or the web
• Food lovers building a personal cookbook
BITE PRO
Bite is free to use, including unlimited imports from recipe websites and up to 15 saved recipes. Bite Pro ($2.99/month) unlocks unlimited saved recipes, Instagram reel imports, scanning handwritten cards and cookbook pages, and generating recipes from your own photos.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Apple Account settings, or in Bite under profile > manage plan.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://navy-octagon-a0a.notion.site/Privacy-Policy-for-Bite-2675ae6213fc80578fcbfae728c7ec4c
Bite is the easiest way to save recipes, import them from anywhere, and build your cookbook. Every favorite recipe comes from someone you know!

 or import a worksheet as a PDF and write right on it. Hold the pen still after drawing a shape,
 arrow, or diagram and it turns into a clean version that can be reshaped afterwards, and scribbling

 A pen and a highlighter, with your own colors; scribble over a drawing to erase it
 Select with gestures, then move, resize, and rotate your drawings, with alignment guides
 Record audio while you write, so you don't miss anything
 Crop a photo of a whiteboard or paper so it is straight and clear, and make the background

 Add stickers, pictures, sticky notes, and coordinate grids
 An endless zoomable canvas with many pages you can reorder
 Present your pages step by step, and export everything as a PDF
 Made for a pen and a touchscreen used together: the pen draws, and your finger pans, zooms,

 Help explains the gestures.

fedora-packages:git-annex/git-annex.description: Git-annex allows managing files with git, without checking the file contents into git. While that may seem paradoxical, it is useful when dealing with files larger than git can currently easily handle, whether due to limitations in memory, time, or disk space. It can store large files in many places, from local hard drives, to a large number of cloud storage services, including S3, WebDAV, and rsync, and many other usable via plugins. Files can be stored encrypted with gpg, so that the cloud storage provider cannot see your data. git-annex keeps track of where each file is stored, so it knows how many copies are available, and has many facilities to ensure your data is preserved. git-annex can also be used to keep a folder in sync between computers, noticing when files are changed, and automatically committing them to git and transferring them to other computers. The git-annex webapp makes it easy to set up and use git-annex this way.

firefox-addons:865295.name: Block Site
firefox-addons:865295.summary: A customizable, password-protected website blocker and redirector.
firefox-addons:865295.description:
This extension will block access to websites of your choosing. A master password controls all customization options, as well as access to any blocked site. It’s also possible to redirect navigation from one specific website to another. 
Preview:
 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=maE-gOUSH4c 
Features:
1. Block unwanted domains. 
2. Prevent access to a range of websites using wildcard matching or regular expression matching.
3. Reverse mode allows access to only some hostnames and blocks access to all others. 
4. Custom redirection; you can redirect a single blocked hostname to a new destination. 
5. Display a custom message on blocked pages.
6. Time and date based blocking. Only block access to the websites at specified times and dates. This feature can be configured per hostname. 
7. Protect data leakage. This extension prevents certain hostnames from gathering network activity from your computer, since blocking occurs before any network request is emitted to the server.
8. Auto-closes blocked tabs after a period of time.
10. Closes annoying pop-ups as soon as the opening request is received.
11. Pause and resume blocking from the right-click context menu of the toolbar button.
12. Supports overwriting configurations by managed storage
For the FAQs and general feature suggestions please use:
 https://webextension.org/listing/block-site.html 
For technical bug reports use:
 https://github.com/ray-lothian/Block-Site/issues

firefox-addons:3012596.name: Manga Translator
firefox-addons:3012596.summary: Scan comic images on reading pages, capture originals, translate, review results, and batch export downloads.
firefox-addons:3012596.description:
Manga Translator is a Firefox extension built for comic reading workflows. It helps users scan images on reading pages, capture original assets, submit translation requests, review results, and export images without leaving the browser.
The extension is designed for image-based comic pages, vertical webtoon readers, and some canvas-based reading pages. After opening a supported or compatible reading page, users can scan page images, preview or acquire them, run single-image or batch translation, check for shared translation results, download original or translated images, and continue reading in reader mode.
Key features:
- Scan comic images and some canvas content on the current page
- Use a side panel or embedded panel workflow to manage current tasks, history, account, and settings
- Preview single images, acquire full chapters, and locate source images
- Run single-image or batch translation
- Check for shared translation results
- Download originals, translated images, or ZIP exports
- Use reader mode and strip merge for long-form reading
- Sign in with email or Google
- Use a multilingual interface
Typical use cases:
- Reading comics in the browser and translating image-based text without switching tools
- Processing a full chapter and exporting original or translated images in bulk
- Reviewing translated pages in reader mode or merged strip format
- Reporting a translation issue with image context attached by the user
Important notes:
- Some sites depend on foreground capture, so the target tab must stay visible during capture-related actions
- Some sites only allow capture of the currently visible area
- If a site blocks page-level replacement, translated images may need to be viewed in preview, reader mode, or downloads
Images are uploaded only when the user explicitly starts translation, runs a translation check, or submits image-based issue feedback.

firefox-addons:2799567.name: Instagram Downloader
firefox-addons:2799567.summary: Help users download images and videos easily on Instagram

firefox-addons:2795559.name: IDL Helper (IG Downloader)
firefox-addons:2795559.summary: Download Instagram videos and extract audio from video with just a few mouse clicks. Supported media formats are MP3, MP4, WEBM. Save button for images from the gallery in maximum quality.
firefox-addons:2795559.description:
Powerful Instagram Downloader. In most cases, you can download MP3 or MP4 file with one click, otherwise, please, follow the link to Instaloader website and use IDL Client software (Windows only). You are able to extract music from Instagram to MP3, thus IDL Helper is a powerful online video to MP3 converter. The extension adds a button to save photos from the Instagram gallery, including those in the carousel. You can also easily download videos from the feed. To do this, click on "View all comments" under the post or on the three dot button at the top of the post and select "Go to post" from the drop-down menu. Then use the download button by IDL Helper. The features of our downloader extension are listed below. See more details on IDL Helper’s page. Download video:
  • in MP4 format with sound ( );
  • with frame rates up to 30 fps;
  • in the highest possible resolutions.
Download audio (from video):
  • in MP4 and MP3 ( *) formats;
  • at the highest possible bitrate.
Important: the list of available download options depends on characteristics of the original file! E.g. initially posted 360p @24 fps video without sound cannot be downloaded in HD @30 fps with sound. Other features of the browser extension:
  • downloaded files have readable (human-friendly) names;
  • you can choose the button style: modern interface (appears on mouse over) and classic interface (appears on click);
  • "embedded" videos loading support, i.e. Instagram videos hosted on third-party sites;
  • button for downloading images in maximum quality, i.e. the ability to save photos from the gallery;
  • ability to download Reels, IGTV videos, regular videos;
  • thoughtful help section with answers to frequently asked questions;
  • several really useful settings :)
( ) In some cases, Instagram stores audio and video streams separately, therefore, to download video with sound they must be “glued” (muxing):
  • for small streams (up to 2 GB in total) the extension itself merges audio and video files, i.e. “on-the-fly” right in the browser;
  • for larger streams it is proposed to use IDL Client utility to avoid “freezing” of the browser tab.
( *) Instagram doesn't support MP3 format. So, to grab MP3 sound from videos, the extension uses built-in audio converter for files up to 2 GB or suggests using IDL Client software otherwize.

bluejetty:00026515:ios.name: Grand Mountain Adventure
bluejetty:00026515:ios.summary: Explore entire mountains in this open-world skiing & snowboarding adventure! Land the biggest cliff drops in the backcountry, freeride down a steep chute, clip the gates in a slalom track, stomp a perfect park run, or just explore the vast
bluejetty:00026515:ios.description:
Explore entire mountains in this open-world skiing & snowboarding adventure! Land the biggest cliff drops in the backcountry, freeride down a steep chute, clip the gates in a slalom track, stomp a perfect park run, or just explore the vast ski resorts - the choice is yours!
Note: 
This is a demo version with the first mountain available for free. Purchase the full game to unlock all 7 mountains and get the twin-tip skis and board.
Features:
- 7 huge open-world mountains to explore
- 100+ different challenges to master
- 10+ different types of challenges (including Super G, Slopestyle, Freeride, Big Air and more)
- Cross-device multiplayer over Wifi
- Game Controller/Joypad support
- Online leaderboards to compete in
- Vivid ski resorts with busy slopes, avalanches, wildlife, and sunsets
- Absolute freedom to ski wherever you want, and ride any lift you like without loading screens or interruptions
- Advanced trick system with flips, spins, corks, rails, combos and more
- 20+ hours of gameplay to complete all mountains
- Zen mode
Winter 2021 Expansion:
The expansion includes three new mountains and can be purchased from within the game. Introducing:
- Pinecone Peaks, USA - A massive resort that combines long pistes, large backcountry areas and a wide range of snow parks, with rails and kickers for all skill levels.
- Ben Ailig, Scotland - Slushy spring skiing in the middle of farms, grazing land, gorges, and impressive rock formations.
- Mount Fairview, Canada - A picturesque resort amid dense forests and slow rivers with flawlessly groomed slopes and thrilling Super G tracks.
Multiplayer:
Gather your friends, connect to the same Wifi and explore the mountains together. Compete in races or try out the new battle mode where you throw snowballs and plant rails to send your friends off the course. Up to 16 players can play together at once.
Gameplay:
The adventure starts at the bottom of Hirschalm, a sleepy ski resort in the midst of the alps. Strap on your skis or board and head down to the lift while picking up the basics like turning and jumping.
Take the lift up to Almhütte and try your first slalom challenge. Completing challenges earns you Ski Passes which are used to unlock ski lifts which takes you to new parts of the mountain.
As you advance up the mountain you have to tackle a variety of challenges like slalom, slopestyle, ski cross, and big air. Now perfect carving turns will not be enough but you also have to start practicing tricks, rails, and drops to complete the challenges. 
And don’t forget to get off the slopes and head into the backcountry areas. Apart from deep powder and clean lines, you will discover hidden challenges and secret Ski Passes. But be careful - outside the groomed runs there are bears, wolves, avalanches, falling trees, and other hazards waiting for you!

bluejetty:00028099:ios.summary: Introducing the ultimate companion for your trip to Pigeon Forge, TN - the Pigeon Forge Pocket Guide app! This FREE app is the perfect go-to source for those visiting the Pigeon Forge area. Say goodbye to tedious Google searches for things
bluejetty:00028099:ios.description:
Introducing the ultimate companion for your trip to Pigeon Forge, TN - the Pigeon Forge Pocket Guide app! This FREE app is the perfect go-to source for those visiting the Pigeon Forge area. Say goodbye to tedious Google searches for things like "where to eat" or "what to do" in Pigeon Forge. With the Pigeon Forge Pocket Guide app, you'll have easy access to a wealth of information right at your fingertips! Now with digital COUPON links!
The app boasts a simple, easy-to-use interface with intuitive categories to choose from, including Activities & Attractions, Places to Eat, Shopping, Shows, Snacks & Treats, Groceries and More Fun Stuff. You can browse through a list of places under each category and select the ones that interest you. 
When a user selects a location from the list, they'll be taken to a detailed view with a wealth of information about that location. Along with a description and pictures, the app also displays a mini-map that shows the location of the venue. The address listed for each venue is clickable, allowing users to initiate Apple Maps navigation to that location with ease. Additionally, users can simply tap on the phone number to instantly call the venue, or click on the website link to visit the location's website in their device's default browser. With these features, users can easily access all the information they need to make their Pigeon Forge experience the best it can be.
The Pigeon Forge Pocket Guide app is packed with information on all of the main attractions, as well as the smaller, lesser-known venues and attractions. It also includes a search feature that allows you to easily find locations by searching their name, tagline, or description.
If you are gluten intolerant, this app has you covered. If a venue has a gluten free menu or an ample selection of gluten free items on their menu, the app will show you a "Gluten Free" GF icon next to their listing.
Now, discovering and redeeming online coupons is easier than ever. When a valuable coupon awaits, you won’t miss it. If a venue has a coupon available, a green ‘Coupon Available’ link will be displayed at the bottom of the venue description. Start saving on your favorite Pigeon Forge attractions, dining and more with just a tap.
In addition, the app provides a dynamic map of Pigeon Forge that allows you to zoom in and out and scroll around the map. This feature helps tourists new to the area get an idea of how far or close they are to these locations and provides a good overview of where everything is in Pigeon Forge.
Lastly, the app provides weather information for Pigeon Forge, including current weather, 24-hour hourly forecasts, and 7-day forecasts, powered by Apple Weather.
Download the Pigeon Forge Pocket Guide app today and make the most of your trip to Pigeon Forge!

bluejetty:00031372:ios.description:
Scan Now turns your phone into a powerful digital office! 
Scan, sign, editor, mark up, add text and icons, erase and convert any document to PDF, TXT, Word, Excel or JPG/JPEG format. 
Download this scanner app to go paperless with our fast PDF scanner and become more productive with all your documents stored in a neat mobile office right on your phone! 
◉ FEATURES:
√ SCAN DOCUMENTS FROM YOUR CAMERA, FILES OR GALLERY
This tiny yet powerful scanner app is a must-have for students and anyone involved in a small business: accountants, realtors, managers, or lawyers. 
Instant scanning speed including receipts, contracts, paper notes, fax papers, books, and many others. 
√ VARIOUS SCANNING MODES
Scan and manage all your important documents such as: 
• ID-CARD & PASSPORT – a mode specifically designed to digitize your ID-documents.
• ALL SIZE DOCUMENTS – scanning all size docs made easy. 
• BOOKS – try our book scanning mode to instantly scan two pages in one shot. 
• BUSINESS CARDS – collect all your leads in one shot. 
• RECEIPTS – save all your expenses, invoices and reimbursements. 
• WALLET – digitize all your cards.
• VOUCHERS – save all your vouchers and warranties so you don't lose them.
• OLD PHOTOGRAPHS – use our HD camera to scan your old memories.
√ QR CODE & BAR CODE SCANNING
Scan and manage all your QR codes and BAR codes. 
√ APPLY FILTERS TO DOCS
Enhance with powerful filters that will make your documents look professional, remove shadows to your scans, port to black and white or adjust contrast and brightness. 
√ SIGN OFFICIAL DOCUMENTATION:
Create and save more than one e-signature. Quickly and professionally sign important documents. Sign any documentation in a few taps.
√ BATCH AND MERGE DOCUMENTS AND SPLIT PDFs
Add unlimited pages to any document. Merge different scans into only one document. Batch files.
Use PDF splitter to import a pdf file and split it in pages. 
√ DOC & PDF VIEWER
Get all your important documents in hand and organized in folders. 
√ DOC & PDF EDITOR
Edit all your documents with doodles, lines, squares, arrows and other drawing tools. 
√ SORT AND ORGANIZE IN FOLDERS
Create folders to organize your scans. Find documents in your scanned library easily by name or folder. 
√ PROTECT FILES
Protect PDF with a password, keep your files secure with face recognition.
√ CONVERT AND EXPORT IN ANY FORMAT:
Export your documents to PDF, TXT, Word, JPEG format. Save and share your documents in the format you need and convert any file to text. 
√ CONVERT IMAGE TO TEXT AND EDIT TEXT WITH OCR / TEXT RECOGNITION:
Automatically extract text on PDF and images and edit it according to your needs. Scan Now OCR (Optical Character Recognition) technology can accurately convert any document to text. 
√ COMPRESS DOCS IN ZIP FILES
Easy sharing on chats or email, reduce file size or compress pdf to zip, making your PDF smaller will help you save space. 
√ SHARE YOUR SCANNED DOCUMENTS:
Email your files as PDF or JPEG. Save your documents to your photo library or cloud storage. Send your scanned files through other messaging apps.
√ PRINT
Using this PDF scanner, you can print directly from our scanner app.
◉ PREMIUM PAID SUBSCRIPTIONS:
This app contains subscriptions!
You can subscribe to any of our premium packages and get the following perks: 
√ Scan unlimited documents
√ Unlimited OCR and text recognition
√ Export documents in PDF, Text, Word or JPEG
√ Export documents in ZIP files
Payment models for Premium subscription:
- Weekly: $12.99, first week for only $0.99.
- 1 Year: $59.99

Feel free to leave a review or contact us at:

Terms of Use (EULA):

bluejetty:00017924:ios.description:
Focus Taiwan’s free news app is the top source of English-language coverage of all things Taiwan, from breaking news to politics, business, technology, sports, culture and much more.
The updated app maintains a similar look to the Focus Taiwan website, but also has a "Media" section, which includes a playlist of the latest 30 news stories in audio and video formats.
In addition to scrolling up and down to read articles and lists of news headlines, mobile device users can also swipe right or left to browse different news categories and articles.
The updated app allows users to bookmark articles and videos in the new "My Stories" feature which can be found in the "Menu" section.
Users will be able to choose the font size and layout of the page to suit their reading habits from the "Menu" section and are welcome to leave reviews or contact Focus Taiwan with feedback.
Focus Taiwan would like to hear from you! Send us your feedback at app_feature@cna.com.tw and help shape our future updates.

bluejetty:00016687:ios.description:
Play Lollipop & Marshmallow Match3 the most delectable match-3 game in a candy wonderland!
If you have a BIG sweet tooth, you’ve hit the sweet spot with the classic gameplay in a rainbow mania of mixed candy drops and lollipops!
Join Jenny on her scrumptious journey to win back the lollipops stolen from the sneaky Marshmallow brothers! Sweeten up the challenge as you crush assorted colorful candies through various quests in beautiful delicious environments, like Lollipop Wood and Fudge Desert.
One of the best casual games for unlimited fun!
HOW TO PLAY
• Swap and match 3 or more candies.
• Remove as many candies in as few moves as possible.
• Create amazing combinations like striped and rainbow candies!
• Earn 3 stars to get more coins.
FEATURES
• Simple and fun match-3 puzzle gameplay
• Hundreds of unique levels with regular updates.
• Various tasty missions, like catch the Marshmallow Brothers, collect various treats and drop sweets to the bottom and much more!
• Create colorful candy combos and use awesome power-ups, like Magic Wand and Honey Stick, to help you with stickier levels.
• Candies can come from all different directions, not just down!
• No time limit so play at your own pace.
• No WiFi required. Enjoy online and offline!
NOTES
• Lollipop & Marshmallow Match3 contains ads like banner, interstitial, video and house ads.
• Lollipop & Marshmallow Match3 is free to play, but you can purchase in-app items like AD FREE and coins.

bluejetty:00041930:ios.description:
Make your own manga, manhwa and webcomics.
Build dramatic romance scenes, cinematic panels, and characters readers won't forget. All from your phone.
You supply the ideas. We'll supply the assets. toongether keeps you in charge of the story: you write the script, compose the scenes, choose the vibe. We handle the canvas, the posing, the backgrounds, so you can go from idea to published chapter in one afternoon.
Drag, drop, write, publish. That's the loop.
FIND YOUR SQUAD
You're not posting into the void. toongether publishes straight to a community of readers and creators who care about webcomics. Read free romance, fantasy and slow-burn series from creators around the world while you build your own. Drop a cliffhanger and watch the reactions roll in. Trade tips. Find a co-writer for your next series.
WHY CREATORS LOVE TOONGETHER
- Characters that stay consistent between panels. Your protagonist looks exactly like themselves from page one to the finale.
- Cooking an enemies-to-lovers arc? Fake dating? CEO romance? Fanfic? Generate the poses, outfits and backgrounds to match in one tap.
- Real layout control. Layer, rotate, resize, stack speech bubbles until the scene looks how you saw it in your head. You aren't just prompting, you are directing.
- Built-in readers. Your chapter goes live in front of manga and manhwa fans the moment you hit post.
- A real community. Co-writers, comments, and a fanbase you build from chapter one.
Start your story today. Who is your main character falling for first?
Terms of Use: https://toongether.ai/terms
Privacy Policy: https://toongether.ai/privacy

bluejetty:00016383:ios.name: Farkle++
bluejetty:00016383:ios.summary:

We bring you the all new Farkle game in
bluejetty:00016383:ios.description:
Roll the dice and test your luck in Farkle, the exciting and addictive classic dice game! Whether you want to play alone, challenge friends, or compete online, Farkle offers endless fun and strategy. 
We bring you the all new Farkle game in a completely revamped avatar which we are sure you will love to play.
In this game, you can now play Farkle alone, or in a multiplayer mode and the best of all, ‘Pass & Play’ on the same device with your friends, family and loved ones and have the best of your times. 
Farkle Rules:
At the start of each turn, the player throws all 6 dice at once. One or more scoring dice will be set aside after each throw. After this, the player may then either end their turn and bank the score, or continue to throw the remaining Dice.
If all six dice are scored, they have a 'hot dice' and continue their turn with a new throw of all the six dice adding to the score they have already accumulated. If none of the dice scores in any throw, the play has 'farkled' and all points are lost for that turn.
Features You'll Love:
*Play Alone – Challenge yourself to reach the target. Never get bored and wait for others. Always keep honing your Farkle skills.
* Multiplayer Mode – Compete online against players worldwide.
* Pass & Play Mode – Play with friends on the same device. 
* Classic Farkle Rules – Enjoy traditional scoring.
* Smooth & Intuitive Gameplay – Simple controls with a seamless experience.
*How to Play:
Roll six dice and score points based on different combinations.
Set aside scoring dice and re-roll the rest—or risk it all for a Farkle!
Reach the target score before your opponent and win the game!
Ready to roll the dice and see if luck is on your side? Download Farkle now and start playing!
Will you play it safe or risk it all for a big win? Download to Find out!

bluejetty:00041426:ios.description:
This powerful mobile app from the Riverine Herald is designed for our smart region. It’s an ambition for our community that runs deeper than the colours we wear to the sports ground on the weekend. It’s an ambition that grows from how we connect every day.
The Murray River and Goulburn Valley are famous for their food, their sport, and their ever-present gaze on the vast sky. The Riverine Herald is known for trusted local journalism that captures the spirit of this extraordinary landscape.
This is a modern local media app built for an Echuca-Moama view of the world. 
Light up
Be inspired by the stories of locals and landmarks
Tune in
Listen to the news and podcasts from your own playlist 
Switch on
Challenge yourself with the smartest puzzles 
Heads up: 
Get updates that matter in your world
Reach out
Share a story with friends, share your subscription with family
Watch out
See who’s made it into the video and photo galleries 
And read on…
Access the newsletters and digital replica of the paper edition 
Download now and step ahead
The Riverine Herald mobile app for phone and tablet is free to download. To unlock access to its full features, you will need a digital subscription.
Existing subscribers can log into the app when prompted, using their current username and password.
New subscribers can buy a subscription through the App Store. Purchase is available in-app for these packages: 
* A Digital Starter subscription for Riverine Herald for AU$12.99 for the first three months. After the introductory period, it costs $14.99, billed every 28-days 
* A Digital Premium subscription for Riverine Herald for AU$24.99 for the first three months. After the introductory period, it costs $24.99 billed every 28-days. 
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account after confirmation of purchase and renews automatically unless deactivated by the subscriber at least 24-hours before the current period. Auto-renewal can be turned off by the subscriber by going into their Account Settings after purchase.
For full Subscription Terms and Conditions, please visit https://www.riverineherald.com.au/subscription-terms-conditions/, and for our Privacy Policy, please visit https://www.riverineherald.com.au/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00014732:ios.description:
Connect the jobsite to the office with SKYSITE, the cloud based construction app that allows you to manage your construction documents, projects, and information from a desktop or mobile device. 
This contractor app allows you to version your drawings and specs by the revision date as it shows on the title block of your documents. SKYSITE’s "Latest documents" feature automatically creates the current drawing set for your project. Markups automatically sync to all users in real time. Upload and store unlimited documents. Offline sync lets you view documents, markup, create punches, and RFIs, all while you are still at the jobsite, even without internet access.
With our construction project management software you can manage submittals, RFIs, punch lists, and photos all within one application; no need to juggle between multiple apps. 
SKYSITE allows Contractors, Owners, Developers, Architects, Engineers and project teams to:
• Manage documents with the app built for design & construction
• Access and share construction documents from anywhere, on any device
• Access the current drawing set, specs and other construction project documents
• Store unlimited information, with no sheet limits 
• Create RFIs
• Create punch lists
• Manage photos
• Access submittals
• Markup, collaborate, and sync in real time
• Search document content (including OCR content), not just filenames
• Auto-Hyperlink drawing sets
• View and markup documents offline
• Sign in using Single Sign-On 
SKYSITE is ISO/IEC 27001:2013 certified

bluejetty:00030459:ios.description:
Creality Cloud App 
Creality Cloud – The Ultimate 3D Printing Platform
Unleash Your Creativity with the World's Leading 3D Printing Community
Creality Cloud is the all-in-one 3D printing platform built for makers, hobbyists, and professionals. Join a thriving global community of over 4 million users and explore a vast 3D model library, AI-powered tools, and seamless built-in cloud slicing. Manage your prints remotely, connect with fellow creators, and bring your ideas to life—all in one powerful app.
Key Features
Explore a Vast 3D Model Library
Browse millions of high-quality 3D models, including thousands of free designs ready for download and printing.
AI-powered search helps you find models faster with image-based search and semantic search.
Discover trending, exclusive, and premium models, curated just for you.
Join themed design contests and showcase your creativity to the world.
Slice & Print with Cloud-Based Slicing
Slice and print directly from your phone—no software downloads required.
Convert STL files to G-code effortlessly and preview sliced files within the app.
Supports 10+ languages, ensuring a seamless experience for users worldwide.
Earn Rewards & Grow as a Designer
Earn points when your models are downloaded, sliced, or printed, and redeem them for exciting rewards.
Receive boosts from active users with platform-issued boost tickets.
Set your own prices for paid models and offer discounts to boost sales.
AI-powered upload assistant helps you tag, categorize, and describe models more efficiently.
Enhanced dashboard - Insights provides real-time updates on model performance, fan interactions, and earnings.
Remote Control for Your 3D Printer
Control and manage your 3D printer from anywhere using your mobile device.
Print 3MF files instantly without the need for slicing.
Control multiple printers remotely with an intuitive dashboard.
Capture and view timelapse videos of your printing process.
Connect with a Thriving 3D Printing Community
Engage with millions of makers and printing enthusiasts from around the world.
Share your projects, seek advice, and exchange ideas to enhance your skills.
Unlock Exclusive Premium Benefits
Upgrade to premium membership and enjoy free downloads of 400+ premium models.
Faster model downloads and slicing speeds for an enhanced experience.
Auto-Renewing Subscription
 Creality Cloud Premium: Monthly (1 month) & Annual (12 months)
Auto-Renewal
Your iTunes account will be charged 24 hours before the current period ends. The subscription will auto-renew unless canceled.
 Cancel Subscription (Apple):
 Go to Settings → iTunes & App Store → tap Apple ID → View Apple ID → Subscriptions → select Creality Cloud Premium → tap Cancel.
Service agreement:
 https://file2-cdn.creality.com/Auto-Renewal-Service-Agreement.html
Who We Are
Creality is a leading global brand in 3D printing, dedicated to making 3D printing smarter, easier, and more accessible. Our mission is to empower creators with cutting-edge technology while promoting sustainable and innovative solutions.
New User Welcome Bonus
Sign up today and enjoy 7 days of free premium membership, including exclusive model downloads and premium perks!
Get in Touch
Creality Cloud is a free and open platform for everyone to explore, create, and share. Have questions or feedback? Contact us at APPservice@creality.com.
Are you a talented 3D designer? Join our Designer Partner Program and unlock new opportunities. Reach out to us at APPservice@creality.com to get started!

bluejetty:00029750:ios.description:
Feel the rush. Own the streets. Become a legend.
Race Max Pro is the most thrilling mobile racing simulator you'll ever experience — an incredible world where street racing, drifting, and drag racing come alive with breathtaking speed, stunning supercars, and pure adrenaline.
LEGENDARY SUPERCARS & HYPERCARS
Get behind the wheel of the world's most iconic, awe-inspiring machines. Race extraordinary legends from Aston Martin, Pagani, BMW, Audi, Ford, Nissan, Jaguar, Lotus, Chevrolet, Subaru, Mazda, Renault, Peugeot, Volkswagen, AC Cars, Rezvani, RUF, and Naran.
Experience the sheer power of icons like the Nissan GT-R R34 Skyline, Audi RS7, BMW M3 GTR, Chevrolet Camaro, Ford Mustang, Aston Martin Valhalla, and Pagani Zonda R. Every car is a masterpiece — and it's waiting for you.
Fans are already dreaming of Lamborghini, Ferrari, Porsche, Mercedes-Benz, and Rolls-Royce joining the lineup — and we hear you. The garage is growing with every update. More legendary machines are joining the race — and the best is yet to come.
THREE INCREDIBLE RACING DISCIPLINES. ENDLESS THRILLS.
• Street Racing: Blast through stunning urban circuits, dominate every rival, and taste sweet victory.
• Drift Racing: Master the perfect slide, chain breathtaking drifts, and earn your title as drift king.
• Drag Racing: Experience the explosive launch, the perfect shift, the glorious finish — nothing beats the thrill of pure speed.
• Events & Challenges: Exciting brand showcases, intense time trials, and thrilling seasonal tournaments keep the action fresh every day.
YOUR DREAM CAR. YOUR MASTERPIECE.
Race Max Pro isn't just a car game — it's your ultimate automotive fantasy. Upgrade engine, turbo, gearbox, nitro, tires, and reduce weight to unleash your car's true potential.
Fine-tune your perfect setup for breathtaking drift precision or unstoppable drag dominance. Personalize every gorgeous detail — custom paint, stunning rims, bold decals, aerodynamic spoilers, and sleek window tints. Build the car you've always dreamed of.
BEAUTIFUL TRACKS. EPIC RACING.
Race across spectacular circuits inspired by the stunning Amalfi Coast, breathtaking Nordic roads, vibrant Far East city streets, and iconic U.S. highways. Every location is a visual masterpiece designed for unforgettable racing.
COMPETE. CELEBRATE. RISE TO GLORY.
Challenge the world in exhilarating real-time multiplayer racing leagues and ranked seasons. Rise through the leaderboards, earn incredible rewards, and prove you're the ultimate racing champion.
Love the freedom of solo play? Race Max Pro offers a complete, deeply satisfying offline career with 215+ thrilling races — no Wi-Fi needed, just pure racing joy.
EVERYTHING YOU'VE EVER WANTED IN A RACING GAME
Awe-inspiring licensed supercars & hypercars
Street Racing, Drifting & Drag Racing — three incredible worlds in one
215+ exhilarating career races across gorgeous global tracks
Deep, rewarding car customization, tuning & building
Heart-pounding multiplayer racing & competitive ranked leagues
Full offline racing — enjoy anytime, anywhere
Exciting updates — spectacular new cars, seasons & events
Download Race Max Pro today. The ultimate street racing simulator is here — and it's absolutely glorious.
Feel the speed. Own every drift. Win every drag race. Your legend starts now.

bluejetty:00027661:ios.name: Files HD - File Manager
bluejetty:00027661:ios.summary: Files HD (formerly known as Downloads Lite - Download Manager for iPad) features a Web browser that lets you save documents to your iPad so that you can work with them offline. It has a built-in file manager, with robust viewer for all iOS
bluejetty:00027661:ios.description:
Files HD (formerly known as Downloads Lite - Download Manager for iPad) features a Web browser that lets you save documents to your iPad so that you can work with them offline. It has a built-in file manager, with robust viewer for all iOS supported document types, powerful photo browser, advanced PDF reader, full Dropbox support, and more.
NOTE: This app does not support downloading of audio or video content.
FEATURES
√ File manager
- Folders support
- Move, rename and delete files
- Search by file name
- Document viewer that supports .pdf, .doc, .xls, .ppt, .txt, .html, .webarchive and .rtf file formats
- Extract ZIP and RAR archives
- Import photos from camera roll 
√ Tabbed browser
- Provides a user experience very similar to Safari
- Supports unlimited tabs
- Tap and hold on a link to open it in new tab or download it
- Fully featured bookmark manager
- History support
- Address bar auto-completion
- HTTP basic authentication
- Form-based authentication
- Integrated Google or Yahoo! search
- Ability to spoof browser's User-Agent string to display web pages like Firefox
- Unified smart search field. Type a URL or search term in the unified smart search field, the browser automatically suggests the closest match to what you’re looking for.
√ Download manager
- Fast downloading speed
- Save pages with images for offline viewing
- Supports resuming of interrupted downloads reliably
- Live download progress bar and speed indicator
- Active downloads badge number
- Add arbitrary download link 
- Always download with correct filename 
- Ability to download file of unknown size
√ Dropbox integration
- Upload, download and manage files
- Sync what you want, keep files on your device
√ Advanced PDF viewer 
- Huge PDF files work flawlessly 
- Text search 
- Tap PDF links to jump across the file 
√ Photo viewer
- Swipe to move between images in a folder
- Zoom in and out with pinch gesture
- Thumbnails view of all images in a folder
- Ability to save images to photo album
√ File transfer
- iTunes USB File Sharing lets you drag and drop files between your iPad and computer
- Supports HTTP and FTP protocols
- Transfer files to and from computer that is in the same Wi-Fi network
- Send files as email attachments
√ Passcode lock
√ Mobile Safari integration
- Bookmarklet that lets you send links from Mobile Safari to Files HD app
√ Multitasking
- Background downloading 
√ Inter-app document interchange
- Other apps can save their files to Files HD app (e.g. Email app can save attachments to Files HD app)
√ Recovery Mode
- If the browser caught in an endless loop of pop-up alerts, go to the iOS built-in "Settings" app, find "Files HD", turn on "Recovery Mode", then force-quit and relaunch the app.
Terms of Use: https://downloadsapp.info/terms
Privacy Policy: https://downloadsapp.info/privacy

bluejetty:00013985:ios.name: CoStar -Commercial Real Estate
bluejetty:00013985:ios.summary: Easily access the information available with your CoStar account from your phone! While away from the office, commercial real estate professionals can now find detailed information on properties, space for lease, properties for sale, sale c
bluejetty:00013985:ios.description:
Easily access the information available with your CoStar account from your phone! While away from the office, commercial real estate professionals can now find detailed information on properties, space for lease, properties for sale, sale comparables, lease comparables, and tenants and benefit from the depth of verified, continuously updated information provided by the CoStar service. With the new CoStar app, you now have access to the most accurate & comprehensive property information available from anywhere, and on the go!
Disclaimer: CoStar™ app is a mobile extension of the professional suite of CoStar Professional services and is intended only for CoStar users.
Features: 
·      Answer questions on the spot with access to CoStar information on your phone
·      Access CoStar’s massive database of over 5.2 Million commercial properties throughout the US, Canada and the UK!
·      View in-depth CRE information around your current location, including millions of photos.
·      Lookup every CRE professional in your area and access their contact information and properties they are associated with.
·      Communicate instantly with a call, email, or text message from the app
·      Perform Live map searches in your current location and see the map update with listing in real time while you’re on the move.
·      Move the map with your fingers or do a lookup to change your search area
·      Search for any property, available space, properties for sale, sale comparables, lease comparables, and tenants
·      Search filters are country specific and criteria options work seamlessly based on where the map is positioned. (eg. viewing London will display UK specific filter criteria)
·      Lookup geographies like cities, counties, postcodes/zips, submarkets, streets, as well as property addresses and building names.
·      Custom areas can be drawn on the map via interactive draw tools for area, radius, line corridor.
·      Analyze properties across all commercial property types.
CoStar’s professional suite of products provide unmatched local market insight and nationwide coverage, supported by the industry’s largest property research organization. With nearly 1,500 highly trained professionals, CoStar field and analytic researchers:
• Log more than 5.1 million data changes per day
• Make more than 1.9M calls a month (60K Calls a day) to brokers, owners, developers and other commercial real estate professionals
• Canvass more than 500,000 properties nationwide annually 
• Take more than 1 million property photographs annually
The result: Comprehensive, accurate and continuously updated commercial property information that helps win clients and close deals.
Note: Continued use of location services (GPS) running the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00039088:ios.description:
Rakuten Link's basic features
■Calls: Unlimited domestic calling
Rakuten Mobile subscribers can make unlimited calls and send Link message to Rakuten Link users, as well as to other mobile networks and landline numbers in Japan and in 66 designated countries and regions through Rakuten Link. Calls to mobile phones and landlines including other carriers in Japan are free when calling to a Japanese number (some numbers not included).
■Messages: Fun group messages
You can create chat groups with other Rakuten Link users for up to 100 people, and share photos, videos, and documents, as well as messages.
■Home: Your gateway to all of Rakuten Group’s exciting offers and services!
As a Rakuten Mobile user, you can now enjoy easier, one-stop access to not only your favorite services in Rakuten Link but also exclusive deals across Rakuten Group services! Call, message, Check data usage and billing, earn points by using the Rakuten Link‘s Super Point Screen, chat with AI, access key Rakuten Group services and do much more - all from one screen!
■my Rakuten Mobile: Manage Account, Check Data Usage & Billing, and Get Customer Support
As a Rakuten Mobile user, you can check your data usage, billing information, payment status, and service details anytime. You can also apply for or modify optional services directly in the app. In Customer Support, you can find answers by browsing categories, searching by keyword, or using chat support.
*Chat response times may vary depending on inquiry volume.
■Wallet : Check Rakuten point status and access payment services easily
Using Rakuten Link's Wallet, you can send Rakuten Cash to anyone, pay and collect Rakuten Points through Rakuten Point Card, quickly check your Point balances such as "Available Points", "Term limited Points", etc., and conveniently access the Rakuten Pay app!
■Rakuten Link Super Point Screen : Earn Rakuten points easily just by looking at ads.
This is the Rakuten official “Point Reward” App. You can earn point quickly and effortlessly without any hassle. It’s not just about earning points; you can also discover promotional information and discounts.
■Missions: Earn points by using the app and participating in campaigns! Earn Rakuten points by using the app and participating in exciting campaigns. You can also check Start 1000, SPU (Super Point Up program), and the completion status of Start Bonus.
Additionally, follow the Mission Official Account and never miss out on current Point Campaigns and other promotions. Look out for updates from your favorite Official Accounts!
■News: Get news and weather info.
You can get the latest news every day and clip news for reading later. You can also check the weather forecast for the area you live in. 
* Certain numbers may not be supported. A 30-second call costs 22 yen when not using the app.　
* Certain numbers may not qualify for free calls.

bluejetty:00037026:ios.name: Read the Labels - Food Scanner
bluejetty:00037026:ios.summary: Takes the guesswork out of what is clean at the grocery store by helping you chose products made with simple ingredients. Curious if a product has clean ingredients? Point your camera at the barcode and get answers immediately. Empower you
bluejetty:00037026:ios.description:
Takes the guesswork out of what is clean at the grocery store by helping you chose products made with simple ingredients. Curious if a product has clean ingredients? Point your camera at the barcode and get answers immediately. Empower your health by making informed choices. Discover the easiest way to transform your shopping habits and nourish your body with the healthiest foods.
The food industry has made food really confusing - no one knows how the food is made, where it is coming from or what the ingredients do to you. The only thing that has been shoved in our face is nutrition facts and selling points on a box – it’s time to discover what’s really inside of the food - the ingredients. This app will help you understand if a food is clean or not clean based on the ingredients. It will highlight which ingredients are good, okay and bad. This will help you make an informed decision. You will be able to find foods you love and feel good again. 
If you choose to purchase Monthly or Yearly payment will be charged to your Apple account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period or free trial. Prices for yearly are $29.99 a year USD, and monthly is $4.99 a month USD. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the App Store after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.
Terms Of Service Link: https://jensmiley.com/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy Link: https://jensmiley.com/privacy-policy/

Dododex provides a comprehensive and frequently-updated guide for every creature in ARK: Survival Ascended (and ARK: Survival Evolved), including taming calculations, kibble and saddle recipes, admin commands, stats, timers, knock-out information for any weapon, as well as original tips and crowdsourced data from thousands of ARK players.

- Taming calculator and guide for every dinosaur in ARK: Survival Ascended/Evolved

bluejetty:00029751:ios.description:
Bear is a beautiful, powerfully simple Markdown app to capture, write, and organize your life.
Take notes, plan your day, journal thoughts, organize tables, create lists and tasks, sketch ideas, link notes together, write a book, and much more. Bear is used by writers, lawyers, chefs, CEOs, teachers, doctors, engineers, students, parents.. you get the picture. Getting started couldn’t be faster—no signup and no account. Just open a note and write naturally.
"My journaling app of choice is Bear" - Kit Eaton, New York Times
* 2017 Apple Design Award 
* 2016 App Store App of the Year
* Editors' choice for 7 consecutive years
* Most of our parents love it
## BEAUTIFUL. SIMPLE. POWERFUL. PRIVATE
- Tools stay out of your way so you can just write
- Sketch ideas on iPad with an extendable canvas and Apple Pencil (and other styli)
- Clip web pages and other content with Bear’s app extension
- The redesigned Info Panel now with Table of Contents and Backlinks
- Use Apple Watch to dictate and append to recent notes
- Support for all the scripts including RTL languages like Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian
- Easily create notes with Siri and Shortcuts
- Your notes, not ours - Bear is private at its core: We cannot see your notes, tags, or anything else
## FLEXIBLE MARKDOWN
- Work in plain text - easy to move between apps
- Still use formatting like bold, italics, strikethrough, links, tables, and more with Markdown
- Combine text styles like bold and underline, even in headings
- Markdown hides for a clean reading experience
- Use WikiLinks to connect notes and build a personal wiki or knowledge management tool
## GET ORGANIZED with #tags, tasks, and more
- Add #tags, #multi-word tags# and even #multiple/nested/tags anywhere in a note for quick organization
- Pin important tags to the top of the Sidebar
- Make important tags stand out in the Sidebar with TagCons
- Add tasks to notes and easily view all notes that include tasks
- Fold sections to get them out of the way
## SHARING MADE EASY
- Export notes to plain text, Markdown, TextBundle, Bear note, and rich text
- Export notes to HTML, DocX, PDF, JPG, and ePub (Bear Pro required)
- Easily share your notes to any third-party app with the Share Sheet
## SEARCH FAR AND WIDE
- Use Spotlight to search your notes from anywhere
- Search for text inside photos and PDFs (Bear Pro required)
- Focus on specific types of notes with powerful Special Searches like @todo, @images, and @yesterday 
## CREATE YOUR COZY SPACE
* Pick from nearly 30 themes for the perfect writing space in both Light and Dark Mode (Bear Pro required)
* Choose an app icon that speaks to your personality (Bear Pro required)
* Set your own fonts for plain text, headings, and code
* Set line height and width, paragraph spacing, and more
## GET MORE WITH BEAR PRO
One subscription enables a variety of features on all your devices and keeps the Bear hugs coming.
- Sync notes between your iPhone, iPad, and Mac via iCloud
- Encrypt individual notes with a password that is entirely private to you
- Lock Bear with Face/Touch ID
- Export to more formats including HTML, DocX, PDF, JPG, and ePub
- Search for text inside images and PDFs in Bear notes
- Over 30 beautiful app themes & app icons
$2.99 monthly
$29.99 yearly
14-day free trial
-----
Price may vary by location. Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your App Store account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will not be able to cancel the subscription once activated. After purchase, manage your subscriptions in App Store Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.

bluejetty:00018813:ios.description:
Love dim sum, but don't know what to order or how to order? Bring this app, find what you like, and tap the speaker icon to hear the dish pronounced in Chinese (Cantonese or Mandarin) using iOS text-to-speech.
I made this app after visiting Hong Kong and trying to crash course learn Cantonese in the food courts. The early focus was just on dim sum and Cantonese text-to-speech and my favorite restaurants, but has since expanded (based on user tips and requests and my own interests) to more broadly cover Chinese and Chinese-adjacent food (over five hundred dishes) and include features such as Mandarin (traditional and simplified), search (English and Chinese), saving favorites, AI camera recognition of dishes, speech-to-text pronunciation practice, basic phrases, and over five hundred restaurants in the US (sorry, I gave up on trying to list every restaurant in the world, it's just not feasible).
Tips:
If the voice is stuck in Cantonese or Mandarin even after switching the tabs in the Practice screen, go to the Settings app, select Accessibility then Spoken Content and check the Chinese voice. If it's not one of the Siri voices, try selecting Siri in Mainland China, Hong Kong, or Taiwan.
If you don't hear the Chinese speech
1) check the mute switch on your iPhone and make sure it isn't on.
2) text-to-speech for a particular voice sometimes seems to require an internet connect, at least on initial use (same with speech-to-text, the microphone practice button).
2) sometimes a device will have trouble accessing the text-to-speech voice (it's the Hong Kong Chinese voice used for Accessibility in Settings), so try turning your device off and on.
Tapping the speaker icon plays back the Chinese pronunciation at half speed to help you learn. Tap the microphone icon to bring up more options, including adjusting the playback speed, switching between Cantonese and Mandarin, and practicing speaking (the speed and language settings are also in Settings).
Aside from the default speed, the speech may sound not quite natural because the app does not play back recorded speech but instead uses iOS text-to-speech functionality, which utters one character (i.e. one syllable) at a time, which may not match how an entire compound word or phrase is normally pronounced (you can hear this effect when using Siri).
The home screen shows categories of dishes. Tap each category to see the dishes. Or tap on the Search button at the top left (some vocabulary items like "takeout" are not in categories but available in via search).
Talk Dim Sum is developed with:
The dim sum icon from Stock Image Folio on Iconfinder.com.
The technicat logo designed by Dakota Snow.
Restaurant link icons from Simple Icons.
Photos from many dim sum excursions.
Regional map images from Wikipedia (Creative Commons License from Wikimedia).
Swift open source packages: AlertToast, ImagePickerView, LinksKit, Qgrid, SQLite.swift, SwiftUIPager, and SwiftyJSON.

bluejetty:00018951:ios.description:

City Bus Pro Driving Simulator is an expert bus driving practice and gives amazing experience of driving bus in a modern city. City Bus Pro Driving Simulator is an addictive and challenging bus simulation game.

This is the Best and addictive bus driving game to reach from part to another part into big modern city coach stations.
Drive wisely & carefully and park the bus very precisely in specific parking area on bus station for picking the passengers and tourists.
There are two modes in city bus driving simulator game ,Night mode & Day mode. Both modes have realistic and astonishing graphics

Enjoy realistic, crazy and challenging hot paced driving of real city bus in this modern city & coach bus simulator with a mixture of bus parking games. • Adventurous & exciting multiple challenging levels.
• Extreme stunts
• Stunning HD and Amazing 3D Graphics
• Day & Night Mode gameplay
• Realistic controls over the city environment
• Easy and free to use
• Offline Play
• Amazing camera view to deliver you realistic bus driving experience
• Free to play

• iOS Optimization: runs perfectly on anything from the original iPad 1 to the latest 5th Generation widescreen devices
This is the game you have been waiting for!
We hope you will like our City Bus Driving Simulator and don’t forget to rate us on iTunes store!
