bluejetty:00033209:ios.summary: It's time to upgrade your piano playing experience. Simply Play is the fun easy app, with unlimited access to all the sheet music you love, fit to your level. Enjoy a seamless experience anytime, anywhere with scores personalized to your ta
bluejetty:00033209:ios.description:
It's time to upgrade your piano playing experience. Simply Play is the fun easy app, with unlimited access to all the sheet music you love, fit to your level. Enjoy a seamless experience anytime, anywhere with scores personalized to your taste and adapted to your skill level. 
Simply Play is the new Piano companion, one app for all your piano playing needs.
- Easily browse & search for what you want to play
- Unlimited access to quality piano sheet music - no restrictions
- Access a curated library of songs across all genres: Classical, Movie Soundtracks, Musicals…
- Enjoy song recommendations based on your preferences & skill level
- Play along with premium music scores, arranged by world-class musicians
- Auto scroll through music notes and adjust the speed to fit your pace
- Preview music & listen to phrases of songs you intend to play
- Personalize & organize your scores in one place, easily access songs you've played with just one click
Say goodbye to fumbling through papers, speedily turning pages and say hello to the next generation of piano playing, digital sheet music. Optimized to your playing needs. 
How it works:
- Place your device (iPhone/iPad/iPod) on your acoustic/MIDI piano or keyboard 
- Easily browse or search specific songs in your curated music catalog 
- Select a song & your playing level, then easily preview the song 
- You're all set! Enable autoscroll to easily follow notes, and begin to play
Simply Play is developed by Simply, creators of award-winning apps Simply Piano, Simply Guitar, Simply Sing, Piano Maestro and Piano Dust Buster. Developed by world-class musicians, the apps are used by millions of players, and tens of thousands of music teachers worldwide with over 1 million songs learned every week. Simply are experts in creating educational and fun music apps for playing & learning piano.
Simply Apps have received awards & recognition for over the last 12 years, including titles such as: 
- "Editor's Choice" and "App of the day" - Apple
- "EMI’s Innovation Challenge"
- "World Summit Award", by the United Nations
- "Best Tablet Game", GameIS
- "Parents' Choice Award"
- "Golden App", Apps for Homeschooling
Have questions, feedback or suggestions? Reach out to play@hellosimply.com
Enjoy Playing!
privacy policy: https://www.hellosimply.com/legal/privacy
terms of use: https://www.hellosimply.com/legal/terms

bluejetty:00021172:ios.summary:

Creating stunning ornamental patterns and mandalas are the focus o
bluejetty:00021172:ios.description:
iOrnament Pro combines beauty, structure and creativity.
You create, you play…you are blown away by your own designs.
A colourful and sparkling treat for digital creatives!
Creating stunning ornamental patterns and mandalas are the focus of this App.
The first steps in iOrnament Pro are as easy as moving your finger over the screen...they can lead to an amazing creative journey... leading to beautiful pieces of art. The fun is in the discovery!
No matter whether you are a casual doodler, a design professional, a child, a craftsperson, or just seeking for a relaxing soothing drawing experience, iOrnament will make your creative juices flow and unleash your inner artist. Get your fingers and pencil ready for a new drawing experience!
Main features:
While you draw on the iPad iOrnament Pro repeats your strokes by rules of symmetry. Highly expressive pens, effects like gold, silver or glitter create a rich variety of styles. Whether you go for highly artistic calligraphy, strict geometric constructions, or just casual doodling iOrnament offers a suitable tool set to create extraordinary designs.
For the Artist
Full support of all possible symmetry patterns and highly expressive pens allow for the creation of stunning patterns. The possibility of image import brings real world elements into the world of pattern creation. Realistic effect pens, precise brushes seamless patterns and the mathematically precise symmetries make it possible to create crisp geometric drawings and glamorous jewellery likewise.
For kids of all ages
First of all: its fun! Starting at the age of four kids can dive into joyful and creative play for hours. Playing in iOrnament is a creative and satisfying experience starting from the very first stroke. Vivid color palettes, glitter, gold, mandalas, varieties of shapes, and much more offer an endless playground of discovery. And while playing children learn basics about the maths of symmetry.
For meditation 
Drawing in iOrnament connects your left and the right brain: the creative and the structural. This leads to a very calming and relaxing drawing experience with even therapeutic effects. It is like playing a flute in a big room with a great echo. You create something, it comes back from all directions and you react to your own creations. Ornamental structures and symmetries can be helpful to focus and relax at the same time.
For teaching
iOrnament gives access to all mathematical possible planar ornament groups. And even spherical and hyperbolic symmetries. It contains an interactive tutorial explaining the maths behind it and can be used to trigger an exciting journey in the border of art and maths. Suitable for both maths and art classes.
For experimenting
Life is exploration and the best way of learning is playing. The possibilities of iOrnament are endless. Go on your own creative journey and find your own unique way of using this app.
Some feature highlights:
– glitter and gold pens and brushes
– advanced color support 
– photorealistic textures 
– hyperrealistic sparkles 
– image import 
– video and time lapse export 
– advanced layer functions 
– on board help center 
– stroke and color post-editing 
– many versatile stroke properties
– clean and well-structured UI 
– embossing effect 
– dynamic responsive pens 
– patterns on the sphere 
– local mandala symmetries 
– Escheresque color symmetries 
– calligraphy pens and brushes 
– mesmerising geometric deformations
– 3D paper models via the iOrnament Crafter 
The predecessor App iOrnament was featured in Apple Retail Stores and used by Apple for graphics on their website and at the WWDC.

Full support of all possible symmetry patterns and highly expressive pens allow for the creation of stunning patterns. The possibility of image import brings real world elements into the world of pattern creation. Realistic effect pens, precise brushes seamless patterns and the mathematically precise symmetries make it possible to create crisp geometric drawings and glamorous jewellery likewise.

For kids of all ages
First of all: its fun! Starting at the age of four kids can dive into joyful and creative play for hours. Playing in iOrnament is a creative and satisfying experience starting from the very first stroke. Vivid color palettes, glitter, gold, mandalas, varieties of shapes, and much more offer an endless playground of discovery. And while playing children learn basics about the maths of symmetry.

For meditation 
Drawing in iOrnament connects your left and the right brain: the creative and the structural. This leads to a very calming and relaxing drawing experience with even therapeutic effects. It is like playing a flute in a big room with a great echo. You create something, it comes back from all directions and you react to your own creations. Ornamental structures and symmetries can be helpful to focus and relax at the same time.


For teaching
iOrnament gives access to all mathematical possible planar ornament groups. And even spherical and hyperbolic symmetries. It contains an interactive tutorial explaining the maths behind it and can be used to trigger an exciting journey in the border of art and maths. Suitable for both maths and art classes.

For experimenting
Life is exploration and the best way of learning is playing. The possibilities of iOrnament are endless. Go on your own creative journey and find your own unique way of using this app.


Some feature highlights:

– glitter and gold pens and brushes
– advanced color support 
– photorealistic textures 
– hyperrealistic sparkles 
– image import 
– video and time lapse export 
– advanced layer functions 
– on board help center 
– stroke and color post-editing 
– many versatile stroke properties
– clean and well-structured UI 
– embossing effect 
– dynamic responsive pens 
– patterns on the sphere 
– local mandala symmetries 
– Escheresque color symmetries 
– calligraphy pens and brushes 
– mesmerising geometric deformations
– 3D paper models via the iOrnament Crafter 

The predecessor App iOrnament was featured in Apple Retail Stores and used by Apple for graphics on their website and at the WWDC.

bluejetty:00042134:ios.description:
Vibemap connects you to meaningful places, people, and experiences that match your unique vibe. Discover local travel activities, including things to do, events, and where to stay. 
Use Vibemap to find places to go, and things to do, based on vibe, activity, time of day and location. Whether your lifestyle is adventurous, social, quiet, family, foodie, free, chill, new, lively, or luxury, sightseeing you'll find places near by that fit your vibe and interests. 
Features:
• Discover engaging local places, people, and experiences in your city
• Filter the map of point of interests and list of activities by your vibe
• Explore walking maps and city guides of local events & places
• Find engaging social gathering and places to make friends
• Share the vibes of places and leave tips for others
• Read travel guides, maps, and stories about cool things happening near you
• Vibe check with your mood and get suggestions for what to do or where to go in the moment
• Customize, manage and keep track of your vibes while unlocking rewards for exploring the city.
• Smart recommendations, tips, and ideas for activities to do near you.
• Essential culture guides and stories that provide a real, authentic city guide
• Easily plan your next vacation destination, getaway trip, or night out with friends
• Pin or save places to the map around you; check in and keep track of places you visit
Explore things to do and events in these cities: 
• Vancouver, British Columbia
• Seattle, Washington
• Portland, Oregon
• Oakland & San Francisco Bay Area, California
• Los Angeles, California
• Guadalajara, Mexico
And coming soon: 
• Austin & Houston, Texas
• Chicago, Illinois
• Mexico City & Puerto Vallarta, Mexico
• New York, NY
We believe that in-person, social relationships are crucial to our well-being. Vibes can lead to unexpected sources of connection. We each have an emotional life whose energy changes. We constantly navigate this changing energy or what we call personal “vibes.” Our mission is to bring people together in real life in order to create a greater sense of belonging for everyone.
Powered by civic data and tools, Vibemap connects you with where you want to be based on your vibe. We pull in event tickets, tours, reservations and city passes from apps including Ticketmaster, Get Your Guide, Goldstar, Tickets, Bands in Town, and many other city guides and venue event calendars. Filter by music, comedy, food, film & books, kids & family, outdoors, tours & attractions, nightlife, etc. We use vibes as a way to make finding things to do less daunting and more tailored to you, so you can create real-life relationships and achieve personal growth.

Privacy Policy: https://rckit.app/rcprivacy.html

bluejetty:00032577:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00032577:ios.description:
Get Ready for an Exciting and Innovative Mahjong Experience!
Welcome to Mahjong Solitaire, a relaxing game that offers a fresh take on the classic Mahjong games! Your goal is simple—match identical tiles and clear them from the board. With lots of levels to conquer, this matching game will challenge your brain and keep you entertained for hours. Can you clear all the levels and become the ultimate Mahjong master? Download now and start your journey in this addictive and rewarding puzzle game!
【Key Features】
• Lots of Free Board Levels: Immerse yourself in a plethora of free board levels, ensuring endless hours of gameplay excitement.
• Auto Fit: Enjoy smooth, uninterrupted gameplay with our auto-fit feature, optimizing the display on your device screen for a great experience.
• High Scores & Personal Statistics: Keep track of your progress with detailed stats and high scores, helping you monitor your improvement in this fun brain game.
• Toggle Sounds On or Off: Personalize your experience by choosing whether to play with sound effects and music or in silence for a more immersive, relaxing game.
• Offline Play: No internet? No problem! Enjoy uninterrupted gameplay anytime, anywhere, with full offline support.
• Simple Pick-Up-and-Play Controls: Jump straight into the action with intuitive controls, designed for easy navigation and quick learning in this addicting matching game.
【How to Play Mahjong Solitaire】
► Tiles are randomly dealt on the Mahjong board, with up to 144 tiles available.
► Match identical pairs of tiles to remove them from the board and make progress in the tile match game.
► Each matched pair vanishes, bringing you closer to clearing the level and advancing to the next challenge.
► Clear all the tiles to complete the level and move on to even more exciting challenges in this fun puzzle game.
► For the great experience, connect online to access features and progress, though offline play is also supported!
【Why Play Mahjong Solitaire】
Mahjong Solitaire is more than just a traditional Mahjong game—it’s a fun and engaging brain game that exercises your mind while providing a relaxing escape. Great for fans of tile match games, match games, and puzzle games, this game offers a refreshing twist on the classic matching game formula. Whether you're a casual player looking for relaxing games or a competitive gamer striving to beat all levels, this game has something for everyone.
Download Mahjong Solitaire now and embark on an unforgettable matching adventure! Unwind, challenge your mind, and immerse yourself in the best Mahjong puzzle game available!

bluejetty:00043696:ios.description:
The Allstate Motor Club application enables any user to quickly and easily request roadside assistance to be sent to their location. Leverage Allstate’s nationwide 24/7 roadside service provider network and your phone’s GPS capabilities to route assistance to your location. Service providers are qualified and satisfaction is assured.
The application is designed to also help Allstate Motor Club members access the benefits of their membership plan. But you don’t have to be a member to use the app.
Download the app and it will:
Track Your Location (or enter address yourself)
Suggest Vehicle Drop-Off Locations
Find Nearest Allstate Selected Service Providers - with shortest estimated arrival times
Show Service Provider Info – company name, phone & technician name
Give Status Updates – shows your technician’s whereabouts on map
Alert Your Family – service sends your family or friends an email on your situation
Provide Live Customer Service Backup – 24/7 in case you need additional help with your request
Services for vehicles outside Allstate Motor Club membership are subject to fees.

bluejetty:00025822:ios.description:
O aplicativo "Agenda da Beleza: Profissionais" é uma ferramenta completa e indispensável para profissionais do ramo que desejam otimizar sua gestão. Com um design intuitivo e funcionalidades abrangentes, o aplicativo visa simplificar e aprimorar a organização diária e o crescimento financeiro das profissionais.
Uma das principais características do aplicativo é o "Agendamento", que permite visualizar e gerenciar sua agenda de compromissos. Você poderá registrar os horários de atendimento, datas e serviços agendados, garantindo que sua jornada seja organizada, evitando conflitos. Além disso, você receberá Notificações de suas próximas agendas, para não perder nada!
O "Cadastro de Clientes" é outra funcionalidade fundamental. Você poderá armazenar informações detalhadas sobre seus clientes, incluindo nome, contato, preferências e histórico de serviços. Isso permite uma abordagem personalizada, aprimorando a experiência do cliente e fomentando relacionamentos duradouros.
O "Controle Financeiro" é uma ferramenta valiosa para o gerenciamento das finanças. Você poderá registrar ganhos e despesas de forma fácil e detalhada, categorizando transações e visualizando relatórios claros sobre sua situação financeira. Você tem também o "Histórico Completo de Ganhos e Despesas", oferecendo uma visão geral das transações passadas.
Para estimular o crescimento pessoal e profissional, o aplicativo oferece a possibilidade de criar "Metas Pessoais e Profissionais". Você poderá definir objetivos para a sua família e para o seu negócio. O aplicativo acompanha o progresso em direção a essas metas, incentivando seu planejamento financeiro.
Com uma interface amigável, o aplicativo "Agenda da Beleza: Profissionais" concentra-se em proporcionar uma experiência otimizada para você. Desde o agendamento até o controle financeiro e o estabelecimento de metas, o aplicativo busca ser um parceiro confiável na sua jornada, auxiliando no crescimento dos negócios e na satisfação dos clientes.

bluejetty:00041558:ios.name: PC Remote
bluejetty:00041558:ios.summary:
Monect PC Remote — your PC, in your pocket.
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a wireless mouse, keyboard, gamepad, and remote desktop for your Windows PC. Control your computer from the same Wi-Fi or from anywhere over the internet — for work,
bluejetty:00041558:ios.description:
Monect PC Remote — your PC, in your pocket.
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a wireless mouse, keyboard, gamepad, and remote desktop for your Windows PC. Control your computer from the same Wi-Fi or from anywhere over the internet — for work, gaming, and everything in between.
REMOTE DESKTOP
• See and control your PC screen in real time with low-latency H.264 or AV1 video and Opus audio.
• Use the screen as a precision touchpad with natural gestures, plus a full mouse, keyboard, scroll, and volume controls.
• Switch between monitors and add or remove virtual displays.
• Type in any language with 16 desktop keyboard layouts, function and media keys, emoji, and Unicode text. Paste from the iOS clipboard and use hardware-keyboard shortcuts.
• Stream in up to 4K with Premium.
GAMING
• Play PC games anywhere with on-screen layouts tailored to each title: buttons, joysticks, D-pads, sliders, touchpads, background touchpad, motion sensors, macros, and scripts.
• Multi-page layouts, custom widgets, and a complete built-in editor.
• Supports Xbox 360, DirectInput, and DSU motion controllers, with rumble feedback on your phone.
• Browse, install, and publish community layouts in the Layout Store.
• Sync layouts with your Monect account, or import .mlo and .mwl packages from other apps.
• Launch console games and ROMs stored on your PC from the Games tab.
MONI AI ASSISTANT
• Ask Moni anything about your PC, or let it look at your screen and help with what's on it.
• Create and edit images, attach photos, and talk to Moni with your voice.
• Answers appear as they're generated, with a live 3D avatar.
Moni runs on your PC and requires Monect AI in PC Remote Receiver.
UTILITIES
• Virtual Camera: use your iPhone or iPad camera as a high-quality webcam on your PC for calls, meetings, and streaming. Custom names and HD/4K output are available with Premium.
• Screen Projector: share your iPhone or iPad screen with your PC, including app audio and your microphone.
• Camera: view and control the cameras connected to your PC.
• File Explorer: browse your device and PC, and transfer files in either direction.
• PC Task Manager: check CPU, memory, disk, GPU, and network usage, inspect processes, and end unresponsive apps on supported PCs.
SECURITY AND CONNECTION
• Encrypted sessions, password-protected PCs, and sign-in tokens stored securely in the Keychain.
• PCs on your local network are discovered automatically. Sign in to reach hosts linked to your Monect account from anywhere.
FREE WITH OPTIONAL PREMIUM
Monect PC Remote is free to download and supported by ads. Free accounts can transfer files up to 10 MB and connect up to 3 hosts. Premium removes ads and unlocks 4K remote desktop streaming, unlimited file transfer size, up to 10 hosts, unlimited game import size, custom virtual camera names with HD/4K output, and custom touchpad themes. Subscriptions renew automatically until canceled, and purchases can be restored at any time.
GET STARTED
1. Download the free PC Remote Receiver from monect.com and install it on your Windows PC.
2. Open Monect PC Remote. Your PC appears automatically on the same Wi-Fi, or sign in to see your linked hosts.
3. Connect and enter your PC password if required.
Requires a Windows PC running PC Remote Receiver. Some features depend on your receiver version and PC hardware.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.monect.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00018154:ios.description:
All your household bills. All under control.
With My Home Bills, you can organize bills, subscriptions, and payments in one place. Stay on top of due dates, see how your spending changes, and find documents and receipts whenever you need them.
From electricity to Netflix, from building fees to insurance: a clear view of your household expenses, always with you.
ORGANIZE YOUR EXPENSES
Add a bill, choose a category, and enter the amount and due date. Include a note and set up daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly recurring payments.
Use the built-in categories or create your own with custom colors and icons.
SEE WHERE YOUR MONEY GOES
Check your average spending by category and your overall monthly average. Explore charts, compare years, and follow your spending trends over time.
From your household overview to the details of a single bill, get the information you need to understand your expenses and see how your costs change.
STAY AHEAD OF EVERY DUE DATE
View payments in the calendar, check unpaid bills, and receive notifications before they are due.
With widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen, useful information is always just a glance away.
BUILD YOUR DIGITAL ARCHIVE
Keep bills and payment receipts together with their details. Scan documents using the built-in scanner or attach photos, screenshots, and PDF files.
Import files from other apps, share documents, or print them whenever you need to. Less paperwork to store, more peace of mind.
KEEP EVERYTHING IN SYNC
Sync your data through iCloud and manage your bills on iPhone and iPad. On iPad, work in split screen and drag images and PDFs straight into the app.
DESIGNED TO MAKE EVERYDAY LIFE EASIER
• Export individual categories as CSV files.
• Add new bills with Siri and Shortcuts on iPhone.
• Use quick actions to access common tasks.
• Protect access with Face ID or Touch ID.
• Enjoy Dark Mode and adjust text size with Dynamic Type.
• Drag and drop images and documents on iPhone and iPad.
My Home Bills Premium
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your account settings after purchase. The current subscription cannot be canceled during the active subscription period. Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription to the app, where applicable.
Privacy: [https://www.myhomebills.app/privacy]
Terms of Service : [https://www.myhomebills.app/terms-of-serivice]
for more information [https://www.myhomebills.app]

bluejetty:00042086:ios.description:
DUVA helps you calm your mind, ease into sleep, and understand your nights with AI support, noise control, sleep tracking, relaxing audio, and connected SomniPods 3 earbuds.
When your mind won’t quiet down, DUVA AI can guide you through breathing, meditation, relaxation, or bedtime support in the moment. When the night gets noisy, use the app with SomniPods 3 to switch noise control modes, play calming sleep audio, and create a quieter path into rest.
DUVA also helps you see what happened while you slept. Track sleep stages, movement, posture, and overnight patterns, then review personalized insights based on your night, routine, and sleep trends. Instead of only showing a score, DUVA helps you understand what affected your sleep and what to try next.
Build a calmer bedtime routine with sounds, meditations, guided sessions, and custom sleep mixes designed to help you unwind.
Key features:
• Connect and control SomniPods 3 earbuds 
• Switch noise control modes and manage playback 
• Check battery status and start your sleep routine 
• Ask DUVA AI for breathing, meditation, and bedtime support 
• Play calming sounds, guided audio, and custom sleep mixes 
• Track sleep stages, movement, posture, and overnight patterns 
• Review personalized sleep insights based on your night and routine 
• Build better bedtime habits for sleep and recovery 
DUVA is designed to support calmer nights, deeper rest, and smarter recovery.
DUVA is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice.

In EnigmBox you have to play with all your mobile phone functionalities.

bluejetty:00036639:ios.description:
This guide brings the look and feel of Animal Crossing: New Horizons to your pocket and gives you a full companion for critters, fossils, and everything else in the game. It includes:
- A NookPhone-style interface
- Insects, fish, and sea creatures with handy availability filters
- A full fossil list
- A large DIY collection with smart search
- A complete villager list with their unique personality traits
- An art collection with tips to tell real from fake artworks
- A collection of songs by the beloved K.K. Slider
- Happy Home Paradise – Browse HHP items and vacation-home content right from your NookPhone
- Resort & hotel – Resort and hotel updates so your island getaway info stays current
- ACNH 3.0 – Fully compatible with Animal Crossing: New Horizons version 3.0
Please enjoy using this app, and leave a review if you liked it!
Escape to a deserted island and create your own paradise as you explore, create, and customize in the Animal Crossing: New Horizons game. Your island getaway has a wealth of natural resources that can be used to craft everything from tools to creature comforts. You can hunt down insects at the crack of dawn, decorate your paradise throughout the day, or enjoy sunset on the beach while fishing in the ocean. The time of day and season match real life, so each day on your island is a chance to check in and find new surprises all year round.
Show off your island utopia to family and friends—or pack your bags and visit theirs. Whether playing online** or with others beside you***, island living is even better when you can share it. Even without hopping on a flight, you’ll meet a cast of charming animal residents bursting with personality. Friendly faces like Tom Nook and Isabelle will lend their services and happily help you grow your budding community. Escape to your island getaway—however, whenever, and wherever you want.
Build your community from scratch on a deserted island brimming with possibility
Create your personal getaway and customize your character, home, decorations, and even the landscape itself
Collect materials to construct everything from furniture to tools! Then, use what you create to give your island a personal touch
Watch as the time of day and seasons match real life—even your hemisphere! Each day holds potential for surprises and discoveries
Get to know the island residents, garden, fish, decorate, hunt for fossils, and more!
Show off your paradise – play on the same system with a total of 4 people***, or play together online** or over local wireless*** for fun with up to 8 players

bluejetty:00016141:ios.name: Carrier Landing HD
bluejetty:00016141:ios.summary:
Carrier Landing HD is a high-end flight sim optimized for iOS devices, offering the following advantages:
Multiplayer Game: 
The multiplayer mode supports authentic Air Combat and Deathmatch modes. You can team up with friends for realisti
bluejetty:00016141:ios.description:
Carrier Landing HD is a high-end flight sim optimized for iOS devices, offering the following advantages:
Multiplayer Game: 
The multiplayer mode supports authentic Air Combat and Deathmatch modes. You can team up with friends for realistic dogfights or join Deathmatch rooms to engage in intense battles with players from around the world.
Aerodynamics:
The aerodynamic model of each aircraft includes multiple components, with careful calculations of their inflow. As a result, the simulator realistically simulates the unique aerodynamic characteristics of many aircraft. This includes the high angle of attack maneuverability of F18 and F22, the ability of F14 to perform a full turn roll using only rudder, the pedal turn maneuver of F35 and F22, and the cobra maneuver of the Su series aerodynamic layout aircraft. The development process involved real pilots for testing and feedback.
Dynamics:
When a 40,000-pound carrier-based aircraft lands on the deck at a descent rate of 5 meters per second, the compression rebound of the landing gear and the damping of the suspension are finely adjusted to create the most realistic visual effects. The recoil force from each bullet is accurately calculated and applied to the aircraft. The simulator also implements rope dynamics simulations for arresting cables and aerial tanker refueling tubes, details that are often not found in many PC flight sims.
Flight Control System (FCS):
Modern fighters often utilize static instability layouts, making it challenging for pilots to fly without the intervention of FCS. The simulator implements an FCS component with the same algorithm as the real flight controller. Your control commands first enter the FCS, which calculates the result using angular velocity feedback or G-load feedback. The result is then passed to the servo to control the control surface. 
Avionics:
The simulator implements a HUD based on the real HUD principle. The size and view angle of the HUD characters and symbols have been strictly verified against the HUD of corresponding real aircraft. This offers the most realistic HUD implementation available in the mobile market. The F18 currently features a fully-featured fire control radar, and fire control radars for other aircraft are also under development.
Arms:
Each missile in the simulator utilizes a real dynamic model, treating them as tiny aircraft. The guidance algorithm employs the same APN algorithm used in real missiles. The guidance results are transmitted to the missile's FCS, which then controls the control surface deflection for maneuvering. The initial speed of the gun bullet in the simulator strictly adheres to real data, accurately calculating the bullet's movement in each frame considering the effects of gravity and air resistance.
Earth Environment Rendering:
The simulator employs multiple scattering algorithms to calculate the color of the sky, ground, and objects, thanks to innovative optimization algorithms. It provides realistic sky colors at dusk and dynamic projections of the earth in the atmosphere. Whether flying at foggy sea levels or 50,000 feet high, you can genuinely feel the presence of the air.Additionally, the game utilizes real astronomical data to determine the positions of stars, the moon, and the sun.

bluejetty:00031364:ios.description:
We developed a weather app designed for motorsport racers. We show short term weather forecasts. We calculate and show the Density Altitude, Grains of Water and HP Correction Factor for tuners to help select the right tune for their cars. We added most race tracks from around the world. You can search your race track by entering it's name in the filter section. If your race track is not listed, you can add it to the list manually! Or you can add a custom location to view weather forecasts from your location.

bluejetty:00024822:ios.description:
Welcome to YidKit 7!
YidKit features an adaptable Home Screen that changes based on the date and time of day.
• Will show Shacharis in the morning, and Mincha/Maariv in the afternoon.
• Shows candle lighting times for Chagim (Jewish Holidays).
• Shows start/end times for fast days.
• Has candle lighting and havdallah for shabbos
Features: Full smart siddur with Tehilim, Hebrew/English Tanach (Torah, Navi/Prophets, Kituvim/Writings), Zmanim, minyan locator/finder (minyanim), kosher restaurant database locator/finder
Full Smart Siddur with Tehilim
YidKit includes full Ashkenaz and Sfard Smart Siddurim with Tehilim! The Smart Siddur will automatically show/hide sections of davening depending on the day. The smart siddur has an adjustable font size and features a Tefilin mirror.
Zmanim
YidKit has comprehensive zmanim. The Zmanim in YidKit includes over 100 different zman variations, so you can personalize your Zmanim based on your customs.
Minyan Locator/Finder
Use YidKit to find a minyan with the minyan locator/finder! YidKit's Minyan Locator/Finder can show you minyan times, locations, and contact info for minyanim nearby.
The app also includes a kosher restaurant database (locator/finder).
Tanach (Torah, Navi/Prophets, Kituvim/Writings)
YidKit also includes a full Hebrew/English Tanach. Use the Tanach to read the Torah, Navi/Prophets, and Kituvim/Writings. It also includes English translation and trop for the Torah, Navi/Prophets, and Kituvim/Writings.
Also includes an Apple Watch app with quickly-accessible brachos!
Terms of use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00035850:ios.description:
Turn dirty clothes into clean profits!
 In Laundry Manager: Wash & Profit, you're not just cleaning clothes—you’re building a bubbly cleaning empire, one spin cycle at a time! Start with a single washer and work your way up to a full fabric-flipping powerhouse. Wash, dry, iron, and upgrade everything around you while keeping customers smiling and the cash flowing. Collect piles of dirty laundry, toss them into powerful machines, and press out wrinkle-free perfection.
Hire helpful staff, sell laundry essentials, and unlock automation to take your business to the next level.
Features:
 ● Build your own cleaning business from scratch
 ● Wash, dry, and iron clothes fast to keep the line moving
 ● Upgrade your machines and expand your cleaning space
 ● Stock and sell essentials like detergent and fabric softener
 ● Automate everything to boost efficiency and profits
 ● Soothing gameplay with vibrant visuals and satisfying mechanics
Master the art of laundry and turn your small shop into a cleaning powerhouse. If you enjoy hands-on simulation games, light strategy, and the satisfaction of progress, you’ll love this one. From stains to stacks of cash, this is the ultimate interactive laundry simulation—where every spotless shirt brings you closer to success.
Download Laundry Manager: Wash & Profit and start spinning your way to the top!

bluejetty:00026508:ios.description:
Hunting Sniper - The Ultimate Free Hunting Experience
Embark on a thrilling journey into the wild with Hunting Sniper, the premier free hunting game. Immerse yourself in the heart-pounding action of stalking and capturing wild animals in their natural habitats.
Unparalleled Wildlife Encounters
Step into a world teeming with real animals, each indigenous to their respective territories. Traverse diverse and authentic hunting locations spanning continents. Set your sights on a majestic big buck, a cunning fox, a ferocious coyote or a formidable bear in the rugged landscapes of Yellowstone Park, USA. Chase after the elusive rhinoceros along the banks of the Nile in Egypt. Venture into the frigid expanse of the Arctic Ocean, Russia, and lay in wait for a massive walrus. Embark on an enthralling mission to capture a dingo amidst the sprawling Australian Outback, and prepare for many more extraordinary encounters. All of this right at your fingertips on your mobile device.
Arms and Arsenal
Marvel at the extensive array of weaponry at your disposal in Hunting Sniper. Experience unparalleled precision, exquisite design, and unmatched quality that enhance your hunting expedition. Elevate your weapon's performance with weapon tokens, allowing you to tailor your arsenal to perfection. And that's not all - complement your gear with cutting-edge bullets bullets to unlock impressive rewards and secure the trophy of a lifetime.
Seamless Gameplay Mastery
Revolutionize your hunting experience with game controls that redefine excellence. Hunting Sniper's intuitive controls empower you to hunt with finesse and pinpoint accuracy. Say goodbye to frustrating gameplay experiences that leave you tempted to toss your smartphone aside. Engage in silky-smooth gun control, mirroring real-life precision.
The Ultimate Hunter's Challenge
Rise through the ranks of the leaderboard and claim your title as the world's preeminent hunter. Hunting Sniper is the sole hunting game that boasts thrilling tournaments and championships. Hone your hunting prowess as you vie against fellow hunters in intense PvP battles. Prove yourself as the unrivaled deer hunting monarch, a title earned through sheer skill and determination.
Soar to New Heights
Can you defy gravity and reach for the skies? As you immerse yourself in the captivating world of Hunting Sniper, you'll find yourself striving for new heights in the pursuit of greatness.
Hunter's Delight
Throughout your adventure, the captivating sights and sounds of the wild will surround you. The words "deer" and "hunter" will become your rallying cries as you aim for the ultimate hunting triumph. Will you seize the opportunity to become the ultimate predator and secure your place as the apex hunter? The call of the wild awaits – answer it with Hunting Sniper.

Vehicle Availability – Members have the ability to see if a vehicle is available before and during their booking. This means that if members wish to extend their booking with a Popcar they can see if the vehicle is available and for how long they can extend the booking till. 
Feedback – Members can give feedback directly from the app and straight to our Popcar support team.
Remaining Time Countdown – When a member books a Popcar, a countdown is available in the app to notify how much time they have left of their booking and know how long they have left before they need to return their Popcar to its designated spot.
Reservation History – Members can view their reservation history on their account, including the distance travelled on each trip they have taken and how much the trip cost them. 
Travel Templates – Members can create templates for repeat bookings. bluejetty:00027647:ios.name: iHunter
bluejetty:00027647:ios.summary: iHunter is Canada's all-in-one hunting app designed for hunters across British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario, Quebec, New Brunswick, Newfoundland, & Labrador, Nova Scotia, and the Yukon Territories. The app is both free
bluejetty:00027647:ios.description:
iHunter is Canada's all-in-one hunting app designed for hunters across British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario, Quebec, New Brunswick, Newfoundland, & Labrador, Nova Scotia, and the Yukon Territories. The app is both free to download and free to use.
Regulations are updated annually upon release by the respective provinces.
By overlaying hunting zones onto various base maps, users can easily determine their current location and the corresponding zone. Users can delve deeper into specific zones to view the open seasons for big game, predators, game birds, and small game. Additionally, they can add their own waypoints, tracks, and drawings to keep track of hunting spots, past harvests, and landowner contact information.
Features (Most functional offline):
• View Hunting zones overlaid on your choice of map.
• Multiple satellite, topographic, and road maps included which automatically caching for offline use.
• Add waypoints to the map at your current location, known GPS locations, or by tapping on the map.
• Log in to back up and synchronize waypoints and preferences across devices.
• Utilize the sunrise/sunset calculator to determine legal hunting light at your location or a waypoint.
• Share your current location with friends or family via email or text for easy location tracking requires internet.
• Display weather at your current location or a waypoint (requires internet).
• First Nations Reserve boundaries.
• Import waypoints and tracks from GPX, KML, and KMZ files.
• Track your position, speed, and altitude; draw over the map; search the map; view recently viewed and favourited items. (Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can significantly decrease battery life).
For each province, there are two subscription options to enhance the iHunter app:
With an iHunter Core yearly subscription, you will receive:
• Access to select hunting zones to view summaries of big-game, predators, game birds, and small game seasons (works offline).
• Ability to select regions of base maps and map layers to cache for offline use.
• Unlimited waypoints, tracks, and drawings.
• Capability to add your own TMS and WMS map layers.
• Wind condition display by location (requires internet).
• 3D base maps.
With an iHunter Pro yearly subscription, you will receive:
• All features included in the Core Subscription.
• CarPlay integration.
• iHunter layers in driving navigation for both CarPlay and in-app navigation.
• Additional public and private land layers. The available layers differ for each province. See https://www.ihunterapp.com/ for more information.
For more information, visit: https://www.ihunterapp.com/subscription-terms-of-use/
Other available purchases:
• Land Ownership Maps (AB): Over 60 county land ownership overlays ranging in price from $9.99 to $29.99 are available for Alberta.
• Land Ownership Maps (SK): Over 180 RM land ownership overlays ranging in price from $14.99 to $21.99 are available for Saskatchewan.
• Land Ownership Maps (MB): Over 70 RM land ownership overlays ranging in price from $14.99 to $44.99 are available for Manitoba.

bluejetty:00022612:ios.name: 5-0 Radio Pro Police Scanner
bluejetty:00022612:ios.summary: Free police scanner app with no subscription or account required. 5-0 Radio is the #1 most downloaded police scanner app since 2009. Use our crime radar to be the first to know about hurricanes, tornadoes, floods, shootings, riots, looting,
bluejetty:00022612:ios.description:
Free police scanner app with no subscription or account required. 5-0 Radio is the #1 most downloaded police scanner app since 2009. Use our crime radar to be the first to know about hurricanes, tornadoes, floods, shootings, riots, looting, protests, earthquakes, bombings, terrorist, radiation, nuclear fallout, outbreaks, biological or chemical attacks, and crime waves happening near you.
Tap into over 50,000 live police, firefighter, emergency medical ambulance, emt, air traffic control (ATC), airport, plane, railroad, trains, ham radio, NOAA weather, news, talk, sports, and music stations.
* 5-0 Radio is a Police Scanner app designed for Pros *
- Free to use without a subscription or any payment
- Live Captions (read what they're saying)
- Rewind a Feed and Share/Listen to Audio from the Past
- Record Feeds and Share Recordings via Email, AirDrop, Text, etc.
- More Feeds than Competing Apps
- Sleep Timer (turns off when you're asleep)
- Police Siren Noise Maker
- Access and Use Cool New Player Backgrounds
- Even more extra Airport/Railroad/NOAA weather/Radio/Scanner feeds
- Get new feature updates
+ More
As seen on ABC News, CNN, FOX News, New York Times, NPR, Wired, Yahoo! News, and various other major news organizations.
Listen to real events happening live in other parts of the world or in your local town. Listen to radio chatter in the background while you run other apps. Listen to new music as you surf the web. Share the stations you are listening to with your friends. They do not need to buy this app to listen to the feeds that you share with them.
* Features *
- "Past Recordings From This Feed" lets you access our archives and listen to past audio from the feed.
- You can rewind time and go back to an earlier time frame in a feed, even if you weren't actively recording the audio.
- “Feeds with Active Alerts” shows you feeds with interesting on-going activity happening right now along with a description of the alert and feed.
- Listen to feeds in the background while you run other apps or write emails/text messages.
- Chat with other listeners in real time.
- International support, including USA, Canada, Australia, UK, Mexico, Germany, Brazil, Malaysia, Thailand, Pakistan, Zimbabwe, Europe, Israel, and more.
- Automatically attempts to reconnect the feed if you lose the connection.
- Browse one of the largest collection of feeds you will ever find in the App Store.
- Search through the feeds with any keywords (enter your city name to find local radio stations).
- Browse through radio feeds by genre (Police, Railroad, Rock, Pop, Hip-Hop, R & B, etc.)
- Customizable Interface. Download new skins for free or create your skins.
- Integrated map finds your location and the location of most scanner feeds.
- List the Top 100 most-current-listeners feeds so that you wouldn't miss an important event
- The catalog is instantly updated as soon as you start browsing it, with new feeds added every few hours.
- Built-in Web Browser; so that you can browse the web while using this app. The built-in web browser is a powerful browser that can block ads.
- Use the built-in web browser to browse the web for more feeds such as air traffic control feeds, weather, and railroad.
- Search for air traffic control feeds by the airport code (i.e. LAX, JFK, HKG).
- Share feeds to your friends by email. All they need is a computer or iPhone to listen to your feeds.
- Listen to feeds on your own desktop computer or laptop. Just email a link to the feed to yourself and open it with a web browser.
- You location not listed here? Add your own feeds. There are plenty of feeds on the internet. Now you can add them all to one app.
- Your favorite feeds show up as soon as you start the app, and they can be sorted/edited by you.
Feed Requests
For feed requests, go to https://SmartestApple.com for more information
Privacy Policy: https://smartestapple.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00040742:ios.description:
Delete Duplicate Photos: Declutter & Reclaim Space
Description:
Is your phone's gallery overflowing with duplicate photos, consuming valuable storage space? Introducing "Delete Duplicate Photos" – your intelligent, fast, and reliable solution to cleanse your gallery!
Key Features:
Advanced AI Detection: Not only identifies exact duplicates but also spots visually similar images that might be cluttering your gallery.
Quick Cleanup Process: Simplified user interface allows you to review and delete duplicates in just a few taps.
Safety First: Review every match, ensuring you never lose a cherished memory.
Optimized Performance: Designed to work flawlessly on both newer and older devices without lag.
Whether you're a photographer with numerous shots of the same scene or someone who loves capturing every moment, "Delete Duplicate Photos" streamlines your collection. Get ready to experience a decluttered gallery, faster phone performance, and regained storage space!
We prioritize your privacy. The app only scans for duplicates and never stores or shares your personal photos.
Privacy policy:

bluejetty:00036536:android.summary:
Daily Quran is a thoughtfully designed app that brings the profound teachings of the Quran closer to Muslims around the globe, seamlessly integrating faith into the rhythm of modern life. 
Key Features:
📖 Read and Listen with Ease
Immerse
bluejetty:00036536:android.description:
Daily Quran is a thoughtfully designed app that brings the profound teachings of the Quran closer to Muslims around the globe, seamlessly integrating faith into the rhythm of modern life. 
Key Features:
📖 Read and Listen with Ease
Immerse yourself in the Quran like never before. Our app presents the original Arabic text alongside an official translation, all laid out in a clear and user-friendly format. For those new to Arabic, phonetic transliteration in Latin script ensures that everyone can engage with the Quran, making it accessible to Muslims from diverse linguistic backgrounds.
🌈 Learn with Tajweed
Each verse is enhanced with color-coded Tajweed markings, serving as a silent tutor to guide you in pronouncing every syllable accurately. This feature is especially beneficial for beginners, helping you master the correct rhythm and intonation, thereby deepening your spiritual connection and enriching your recitation experience.
🕌 Stay Connected to Your Faith
Never miss a moment of prayer. Our app allows you to easily find prayer times and the direction of Qibla based on your geographical location. Whether you’re traveling, at work, or in an unfamiliar place, you can stay connected to your faith with just a few taps.
🌟 Personalized Experience
Tailor your Quran journey to suit your preferences: 
- Bookmark your favorite verses 🔖 for quick access.
- Adjust font size 🔍 for comfortable reading.
Our intuitive interface ensures effortless navigation, allowing you to find and explore the surahs that resonate with you.
🤲🏼 Enhance Your Worship
Elevate your worship experience with features designed for your convenience: 
- Read and listen to the Quran anytime, anywhere, fitting seamlessly into your daily routine.
- Control audio playback for a smooth listening experience, allowing you to pause, rewind, or skip as needed.
- Resume reading from where you left off, ensuring a continuous and engaging experience.
- Switch modes effortlessly for a comfortable reading experience, whether day or night.
📿Stay Closer to Allah
Maintain a strong connection with Allah. The Tasbih feature allows you to conveniently engage in daily remembrance (Dhikr), such as سبحان الله (Glory be to Allah, who is Exalted), الحمد لله (All praise is due to Allah), and الله أكبر(Allah is the Greatest, beyond comparison). You can customize personal prayers, track recitation counts, and use reminders to help you stay closer to Allah in your daily life.
Embark on a Transformative Spiritual Journey
With Daily Quran, you are invited to deepen your understanding and connection to the divine. This app is designed to elevate your worship experience, making the teachings of the Quran an integral part of your life.

apple-macos:6825614660.name: Ahyl Music
apple-macos:6825614660.description:
Ahyl Music — Your Music, Your Way
Ahyl Music is a simple player for your own music files.
KEY FEATURES
• Multiple Music Sources: Play music stored on this device, in iCloud Drive, or on your WebDAV servers.
• Easy Import: Import music through the Files app or transfer files over Wi-Fi.
• Word-by-Word Lyrics: Enjoy synchronized lyrics with word-by-word highlighting.
• Now Playing Styles: Choose an artwork style and background.
• Music Library: Browse by album, artist, and playlist, with search and favorites.
• No Account Required: Enjoy your music without signing up or seeing ads.
Ahyl Music doesn’t include a streaming catalog. Please import music you have the rights to use.
AHYL MUSIC PRO
Core music playback, synchronized lyrics, and basic library features are free. Optional PRO features require an in-app purchase.
PRO unlocks additional Now Playing styles and personalization, manual equalizer and reverb, Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, editing albums, lyrics, other tags, and artwork, playback clips, unlimited playlists and WebDAV servers, and listening history charts and calendar.
Explore weekly, monthly, and yearly listening trends, compare daily averages with the previous period, and tap a bar to view a specific day or month. See your streak, total listening time, longest day, most played songs and artists, and times of day, plus a listening calendar.
Choose an auto-renewable yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. Both options unlock the same PRO features. Each comes as a plan for iPhone and iPad only, or as a "+ Mac" plan that also works on Mac. Prices are shown in the app before purchase.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm your purchase. The yearly subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in Settings > your name > Subscriptions. The lifetime option is a one-time purchase and does not renew. You can restore previous purchases from the PRO page.
Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA):
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy:
https://chaoahyl.com/ahylmusic/privacy/

apple-macos:6762469903.name: Vaporcast
apple-macos:6762469903.description:
Your weather, the way TV used to do it.
Vaporcast is a retro weather dashboard for iPad, Apple TV and macOS — a love letter to the 1990s broadcast era fused with vaporwave aesthetics. 
Set it running in the living room and let local forecasts, hourly outlooks, national temps, and moon phases cycle by like the weather channel you left on in the background as a kid.
Behind the CRT scanlines and neon gradients is real weather from Apple WeatherKit: current conditions, 5-day forecast, alerts, sunrise/sunset, barometer, UV, tomorrow's daylight delta, and more — each on its own rotating panel.
Optional: tap into Apple Music for a smooth-jazz, synthwave, lo-fi, or classical chill backdrop. No subscription? Spotify or whatever you're already playing keeps going — we stay out of the way.
No account. No tracking. No ads. No IAP. Just weather, music, and a beat of CRT nostalgia.

apple-macos:6779970822.name: Phrase: AI Meeting Note Taker
apple-macos:6779970822.description:
Phrase is an AI note taker for meetings, lectures, and voice notes on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch. Record or import audio, get a transcript in 100+ languages and a clear summary, then edit any part of the note.
At work, meetings become notes with the decisions and to-dos. With Pro, Phrase adds them to Reminders and drafts the recap, and it asks first.
In class, lectures become study notes. With Pro, turn them into flashcards and quizzes.
FOR WORK
• Meeting notes and minutes: a summary, the decisions, and action items with owners and due dates when they're mentioned.
• Record in-person meetings, 1:1s, client meetings, interviews, and research sessions. It's bot-free: nothing joins your meeting.
• With Pro, ask Phrase to add action items to Reminders, put the next meeting on your Calendar, or draft a recap email or message. Phrase asks for your OK first and never sends anything on its own.
• With Pro, ask the assistant across all your notes, like "What did we decide about pricing?" Answers show the notes they came from.
FOR STUDENTS
• Lectures and classes become study notes: key ideas, terms and definitions, examples, and assignments.
• Turn a PDF, lecture slides, or up to 8 photos of the whiteboard into one organized note.
• With Pro, review with flashcards, quizzes, and mind maps made from your own notes.
USE IT FOR
Team meetings, 1:1s, client meetings, interviews, lectures, seminars, study groups, research, brainstorms, sermons and talks, voice memos, and audio or video files you already have.
AI NOTES YOU CAN ACTUALLY EDIT
Every note is a document you can edit, not a read-only summary. Retype a line, drag a section, check off to-dos, and add headings, colors, images, code, math, or diagrams. Undo any change. With Pro, ask Phrase to rewrite a section, see exactly what changed, and undo it in one tap.
CHECK THE SOURCE
The original stays attached. Play the audio with a timestamped, speaker-labeled transcript that follows along, and tap any line to jump to that moment. Phrase transcribes 100+ languages and keeps up when a conversation switches languages.
TURN NOTES INTO SOMETHING NEW
With Pro, ask for a slide deck, a one-page brief, a dashboard, flashcards, a quiz, or a mind map. Present decks on an external display or export them as PDF.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No sign-up and no Phrase account. Phrase is local-first: your notes live on your iPhone, iPad, and Mac, and with Pro they sync through your own iCloud. We never store your notes.
QUICK ANSWERS
• Does a bot join my meeting? No. Phrase records the room from your iPhone, iPad, Mac, or Apple Watch.
• Does it work on Mac? Yes. Phrase is a native Mac app with the same features, recording included, and one subscription covers iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
• How do I start recording fast? Jump straight to a new recording from Control Center, the Lock Screen, or Siri, or start one on Apple Watch.
• Do I need an account? No. There's no sign-up, and your notes stay on your devices and in your own iCloud.
PHRASE PRO
Phrase Pro unlocks more AI notes from recordings and files, Ask AI, the assistant, flashcards, decks and other Artifacts, iCloud sync, and unlimited notes. AI features have usage limits. One subscription works on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings.
Please get consent before you record other people.
Phrase is made by Eversight Studio LLC. Website: https://phrase.so
Privacy Policy: https://phrase.so/privacy
Terms of Use: https://phrase.so/terms
